enumeratedValue.name: RSTGSM_0
enumeratedValue.description: Idle, waiting for the first data pattern write.

enumeratedValue.name: RSTGSM_1
enumeratedValue.description: Waiting for the second data pattern write

enumeratedValue.name: RSTGSM_2
enumeratedValue.description: After the reset is performed, this machine returns to the idle (waiting for the first data pattern write) state. The "01" state persists for only a single clock cycle. Software cannot observe this state.

enumeratedValue.name: RSTGSM_3
enumeratedValue.description: This state encoding is never used and is therefore reserved.

enumeratedValue.name: FEATURE_3
enumeratedValue.description: Standard feature set with Filter and Combine registers implemented.

enumeratedValue.name: FEATURE_7
enumeratedValue.description: Standard feature set with Filter, Combine and Quadrature registers implemented.

enumeratedValue.name: CMOD_1
enumeratedValue.description: TPM counter increments on every TPM counter clock

enumeratedValue.name: CMOD_2
enumeratedValue.description: TPM counter increments on rising edge of TPM_EXTCLK synchronized to the TPM counter clock

enumeratedValue.name: CMOD_3
enumeratedValue.description: TPM counter increments on rising edge of the selected external input trigger.

enumeratedValue.name: CPWMS_0
enumeratedValue.description: TPM counter operates in up counting mode.

enumeratedValue.name: CPWMS_1
enumeratedValue.description: TPM counter operates in up-down counting mode.

enumeratedValue.name: TOIE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disable TOF interrupts. Use software polling or DMA request.

enumeratedValue.name: TOIE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enable TOF interrupts. An interrupt is generated when TOF equals one.

enumeratedValue.name: COMSWAP0_0
enumeratedValue.description: Even channel is used for input capture and 1st compare.

enumeratedValue.name: COMSWAP0_1
enumeratedValue.description: Odd channel is used for input capture and 1st compare.

enumeratedValue.name: COMSWAP1_0
enumeratedValue.description: Even channel is used for input capture and 1st compare.

enumeratedValue.name: COMSWAP1_1

enumeratedValue.name: MSBF_1
enumeratedValue.description: MSB (bit9, bit8, bit7 or bit6) is the first bit that is transmitted following the start bit depending on the setting of CTRL[M], CTRL[PE] and BAUD[M10]. Further, the first bit received after the start bit is identified as bit9, bit8, bit7 or bit6 depending on the setting of CTRL[M] and CTRL[PE].

enumeratedValue.name: TXCTSE_0
enumeratedValue.description: CTS has no effect on the transmitter.

enumeratedValue.name: TXCTSE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enables clear-to-send operation. The transmitter checks the state of CTS each time it is ready to send a character. If CTS is asserted, the character is sent. If CTS is deasserted, the signal TXD remains in the mark state and transmission is delayed until CTS is asserted. Changes in CTS as a character is being sent do not affect its transmission.

enumeratedValue.name: TXRTSE_0
enumeratedValue.description: The transmitter has no effect on RTS.

enumeratedValue.name: TXRTSE_1
enumeratedValue.description: When a character is placed into an empty transmitter data buffer , RTS asserts one bit time before the start bit is transmitted. RTS deasserts one bit time after all characters in the transmitter data buffer and shift register are completely sent, including the last stop bit.

enumeratedValue.name: RXRTSE_0
enumeratedValue.description: The receiver has no effect on RTS.

enumeratedValue.name: RXRTSE_1
enumeratedValue.description: RTS is deasserted if the receiver data register is full or a start bit has been detected that would cause the receiver data register to become full. RTS is asserted if the receiver data register is not full and has not detected a start bit that would cause the receiver data register to become full.

enumeratedValue.name: TXCTSSRC_1
enumeratedValue.description: CTS input is the inverted Receiver Match result.

enumeratedValue.description: LPI2C Master will treat a received NACK as if it (NACK) was an ACK

enumeratedValue.name: TIMECFG_0
enumeratedValue.description: Pin Low Timeout Flag will set if SCL is low for longer than the configured timeout

enumeratedValue.name: TIMECFG_1
enumeratedValue.description: Pin Low Timeout Flag will set if either SCL or SDA is low for longer than the configured timeout

enumeratedValue.name: MATCFG_2
enumeratedValue.description: Match is enabled (1st data word equals MATCH0 OR MATCH1)

enumeratedValue.name: MATCFG_3
enumeratedValue.description: Match is enabled (any data word equals MATCH0 OR MATCH1)

enumeratedValue.name: MATCFG_4
enumeratedValue.description: Match is enabled (1st data word equals MATCH0 AND 2nd data word equals MATCH1)

enumeratedValue.name: MATCFG_5
enumeratedValue.description: Match is enabled (any data word equals MATCH0 AND next data word equals MATCH1)

enumeratedValue.name: MATCFG_6
enumeratedValue.description: Match is enabled (1st data word AND MATCH1 equals MATCH0 AND MATCH1)

enumeratedValue.name: MATCFG_7
enumeratedValue.description: Match is enabled (any data word AND MATCH1 equals MATCH0 AND MATCH1)

enumeratedValue.name: PINCFG_4
enumeratedValue.description: 2-pin open drain mode with separate LPI2C slave

enumeratedValue.name: PINCFG_5
enumeratedValue.description: 2-pin output only mode (ultra-fast mode) with separate LPI2C slave

enumeratedValue.name: PINCFG_6
enumeratedValue.description: 2-pin push-pull mode with separate LPI2C slave

enumeratedValue.name: CMD_4
enumeratedValue.description: Generate (repeated) START and transmit address in DATA[7:0]

enumeratedValue.name: CMD_5
enumeratedValue.description: Generate (repeated) START and transmit address in DATA[7:0]. This transfer expects a NACK to be returned.

enumeratedValue.name: CMD_6
enumeratedValue.description: Generate (repeated) START and transmit address in DATA[7:0] using high speed mode

enumeratedValue.name: CMD_7
enumeratedValue.description: Generate (repeated) START and transmit address in DATA[7:0] using high speed mode. This transfer expects a NACK to be returned.

enumeratedValue.name: RST_0
enumeratedValue.description: Slave mode logic is not reset

enumeratedValue.name: FILTEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disable digital filter and output delay counter for slave mode

enumeratedValue.name: FILTEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enable digital filter and output delay counter for slave mode

enumeratedValue.name: FILTDZ_0
enumeratedValue.description: Filter remains enabled in Doze mode

enumeratedValue.name: FILTDZ_1
enumeratedValue.description: Filter is disabled in Doze mode

enumeratedValue.name: RTF_1
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Data Register is now empty

enumeratedValue.name: RRF_1
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Data Register is now empty

enumeratedValue.name: AVF_0
enumeratedValue.description: Address Status Register is not valid

enumeratedValue.name: RSF_0
enumeratedValue.description: Slave has not detected a Repeated START condition

enumeratedValue.name: RSF_1
enumeratedValue.description: Slave has detected a Repeated START condition

enumeratedValue.name: SDF_0
enumeratedValue.description: Slave has not detected a STOP condition

enumeratedValue.name: SDF_1
enumeratedValue.description: Slave has detected a STOP condition

enumeratedValue.name: BEF_0
enumeratedValue.description: Slave has not detected a bit error

enumeratedValue.name: BEF_1
enumeratedValue.description: Slave has detected a bit error

enumeratedValue.name: FEF_0

enumeratedValue.name: FEF_1

enumeratedValue.name: AM0F_0

enumeratedValue.name: AM0F_1

enumeratedValue.name: AM1F_0

enumeratedValue.name: AM1F_1

enumeratedValue.name: GCF_0

enumeratedValue.name: GCF_1

enumeratedValue.name: SARF_0

enumeratedValue.name: SARF_1
enumeratedValue.description: SMBus Alert Response is enabled and detected

enumeratedValue.name: TXCFG_0

enumeratedValue.name: TXCFG_1
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Data Flag will assert whenever the Transmit Data register is empty

enumeratedValue.name: RXCFG_0
enumeratedValue.description: Reading the Receive Data register will return received data and clear the Receive Data flag (MSR[RDF]).

enumeratedValue.name: RXCFG_1
enumeratedValue.description: Reading the Receive Data register when the Address Valid flag (SSR[AVF])is set, will return the Address Status register and clear the Address Valid flag. Reading the Receive Data register when the Address Valid flag is clear, will return received data and clear the Receive Data flag (MSR[RDF]).

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_num_lanes
field.description: Sets the number of active lanes that are to be used for transmitting data. 2'b00 - 1 Lane 2'b01 - 2 Lanes 2'b10 - 3 Lanes 2'b11 - 4 Lanes

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_noncontinuous_clk
field.description: Sets the Host Controller into non-continuous MIPI clock mode. When in non-continuous clock mode, the high speed clock will transistion into low power mode between transmissions. 1'b0 - Continuous high speed clock 1'b1 - Non-Continuous high speed clock

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_t_pre
field.description: Sets the number of byte clock periods ('clk_byte' input) that the controller will wait after enabling the clock lane for HS operation before enabling the data lanes for HS operation. This setting represents the TCLK-PRE DPHY timing parameter. The minimum value for this port is 1.

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_t_post
field.description: Sets the number of byte clock periods ('clk_byte' input) to wait before putting the clock lane into LP mode after the data lanes have been detected to be in Stop State. This setting represents the DPHY timing parameters TLPX + TCLK-PREPARE + TCLK-ZERO + TCLK-PRE requirement for the clock lane before the data lane is allowed to change from LP11 to start a high speed transmission. The minimum value for this port is 1.

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_tx_gap
field.description: Sets the number of byte clock periods ('clk_byte' input) that the controller will wait after the clock lane has been put into LP mode before enabling the clock lane for HS mode again. This setting represents the THS-EXIT DPHY timing parameter. The minimum value for this port is 1.

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_autoinsert_eotp
field.description: Enables the Host Controller to automatically insert an EoTp short packet when switching from HS to LP mode. 1'b0 - EoTp is not automatically inserted 1'b1 - EoTp is automatically inserted

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_extra_cmds_after_eotp
field.description: Configures the DSI Host Controller to send extra End Of Transmission Packets after the end of a packet. The value is the number of extra EOTP packets sent.

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_htx_to_count
field.description: Sets the value of the DSI Host High Speed TX timeout count in clk_byte clock periods that once reached will initiate a timeout error and follow the recovery procedure documented in the DSI specification.

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_lrx_h_to_count
field.description: Sets the value of the DSI Host low power RX timeout count in clk_byte clock periods that once reached will initiate a timeout error and follow the recovery procedure documented in the DSI specification.

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_bta_h_to_count
field.description: Sets the value of the DSI Host Bus Turn Around (BTA) timeout in clk_byte clock periods that once reached will initiate a timeout error.

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_twakeup
field.description: DPHY Twakeup timing parameter. Sets the number of clk_esc clock periods to keep a clock or data lane in Mark-1 state after exiting ULPS. The MIPI DPHY spec requires a minimum of 1ms in Mark-1 state after leaving ULPS.

field.name: dsi_host_rx_error_status
field.description: Status Register for Host receive error detection, ECC errors, CRC errors and for timeout indicators [0] ECC single bit error detected [1] ECC multi bit error detected [6:2] Errored bit position for single bit ECC error [7] CRC error detected [8] High Speed forward TX timeout detected [9] Reverse Low power data receive timeout detected [10] BTA timeout detected

enumeratedValue.name: POUTC_0
enumeratedValue.description: Output pin is set at rollover and cleared at comparison

enumeratedValue.name: POUTC_1
enumeratedValue.description: Output pin is cleared at rollover and set at comparison

enumeratedValue.name: HCTR_0
enumeratedValue.description: Half word swapping does not take place

enumeratedValue.name: HCTR_1
enumeratedValue.description: Half words from write data bus are swapped

enumeratedValue.name: FWM_0
enumeratedValue.description: FIFO empty flag is set when there are more than or equal to 1 empty slots in FIFO

enumeratedValue.name: FWM_1
enumeratedValue.description: FIFO empty flag is set when there are more than or equal to 2 empty slots in FIFO

enumeratedValue.name: FWM_2
enumeratedValue.description: FIFO empty flag is set when there are more than or equal to 3 empty slots in FIFO

enumeratedValue.name: FWM_3
enumeratedValue.description: FIFO empty flag is set when there are more than or equal to 4 empty slots in FIFO

enumeratedValue.name: FE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Data level is above water mark

enumeratedValue.name: FE_1
enumeratedValue.description: When the data level falls below the mark set by FWM field

enumeratedValue.name: FEATURE_2
enumeratedValue.description: Master only, with standard feature set

enumeratedValue.name: FEATURE_3
enumeratedValue.description: Master and slave, with standard feature set

enumeratedValue.name: DOZEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Master is enabled in Doze mode

enumeratedValue.name: DOZEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Master is disabled in Doze mode

enumeratedValue.name: DBGEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Master is disabled in debug mode

enumeratedValue.name: DBGEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Master is enabled in debug mode

enumeratedValue.name: EPF_0
enumeratedValue.description: Master has not generated a STOP or Repeated START condition

enumeratedValue.name: EPF_1
enumeratedValue.description: Master has generated a STOP or Repeated START condition

enumeratedValue.name: SDF_0
enumeratedValue.description: Master has not generated a STOP condition

enumeratedValue.name: SDF_1
enumeratedValue.description: Master has generated a STOP condition

enumeratedValue.name: FEF_1
enumeratedValue.description: Master sending or receiving data without a START condition

enumeratedValue.name: PLTF_0
enumeratedValue.description: Pin low timeout has not occurred or is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: HRSEL_0
enumeratedValue.description: Host request input is pin HREQ

enumeratedValue.name: HRSEL_1
enumeratedValue.description: Host request input is input trigger

enumeratedValue.name: RDMO_0
enumeratedValue.description: Received data is stored in the receive FIFO

enumeratedValue.name: RDMO_1
enumeratedValue.description: Received data is discarded unless the the Data Match Flag (MSR[DMF]) is set

enumeratedValue.name: AUTOSTOP_1
enumeratedValue.description: STOP condition is automatically generated whenever the transmit FIFO is empty and the LPI2C master is busy

enumeratedValue.name: IGNACK_0
enumeratedValue.description: LPI2C Master will receive ACK and NACK normally

enumeratedValue.name: IGNACK_1
enumeratedValue.description: LPI2C Master will treat a received NACK as if it (NACK) was an ACK

enumeratedValue.name: TIMECFG_0
enumeratedValue.description: Pin Low Timeout Flag will set if SCL is low for longer than the configured timeout

enumeratedValue.name: TIMECFG_1
enumeratedValue.description: Pin Low Timeout Flag will set if either SCL or SDA is low for longer than the configured timeout

enumeratedValue.name: MATCFG_2
enumeratedValue.description: Match is enabled (1st data word equals MATCH0 OR MATCH1)

enumeratedValue.name: MATCFG_3
enumeratedValue.description: Match is enabled (any data word equals MATCH0 OR MATCH1)

enumeratedValue.name: MATCFG_4
enumeratedValue.description: Match is enabled (1st data word equals MATCH0 AND 2nd data word equals MATCH1)

enumeratedValue.name: MATCFG_5
enumeratedValue.description: Match is enabled (any data word equals MATCH0 AND next data word equals MATCH1)

enumeratedValue.name: MATCFG_6
enumeratedValue.description: Match is enabled (1st data word AND MATCH1 equals MATCH0 AND MATCH1)

enumeratedValue.name: MATCFG_7
enumeratedValue.description: Match is enabled (any data word AND MATCH1 equals MATCH0 AND MATCH1)

enumeratedValue.name: PINCFG_4
enumeratedValue.description: 2-pin open drain mode with separate LPI2C slave

enumeratedValue.name: PINCFG_5
enumeratedValue.description: 2-pin output only mode (ultra-fast mode) with separate LPI2C slave

enumeratedValue.name: PINCFG_6
enumeratedValue.description: 2-pin push-pull mode with separate LPI2C slave

enumeratedValue.name: CMD_4

enumeratedValue.name: CMD_7

enumeratedValue.name: DBGCMD_1
enumeratedValue.description: GO. This command changes the FP mode from interactive debug mode to normal execution mode. This command is only active when FP is in interactive debug mode.

enumeratedValue.name: DBGCMD_2
enumeratedValue.description: STEP. This command advances the FP mode one instruction further. This command is only active when FP is in interactive debug mode.

enumeratedValue.name: DBGCMD_4
enumeratedValue.description: MANUAL INSTRUCTION. This command forces the FP to put the manual instruction into pipeline for execution in the next running cycle. This command is only active when FP is in interactive debug mode.

enumeratedValue.name: DBGCMD_5
enumeratedValue.description: FORCE_BREAKPOINT. Force the FP into the interactive debug mode.

enumeratedValue.name: ENMOD_1

enumeratedValue.name: ECX_1
enumeratedValue.description: Cancel the remaining data transfer in the same fashion as the CX bit. Stop the executing channel and force the minor loop to finish. The cancel takes effect after the last write of the current read/write sequence. The ECX bit clears itself after the cancel is honored. In addition to cancelling the transfer, ECX treats the cancel as an error condition, thus updating the Error Status register (DMAx_ES) and generating an optional error interrupt.

enumeratedValue.name: CX_1
enumeratedValue.description: Cancel the remaining data transfer. Stop the executing channel and force the minor loop to finish. The cancel takes effect after the last write of the current read/write sequence. The CX bit clears itself after the cancel has been honored. This cancel retires the channel normally as if the minor loop was completed.

enumeratedValue.name: ESDA_1
enumeratedValue.description: The store destination address to system memory operation is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: BWC_3

enumeratedValue.description: The DMA hardware request signal for the corresponding channel is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ERQ_1
enumeratedValue.description: The DMA hardware request signal for the corresponding channel is enabled.

field.name: EARQ
field.description: Enable Asynchronous DMA Request in stop mode for channel

enumeratedValue.name: EARQ_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disable asynchronous DMA request for the channel.

enumeratedValue.name: EARQ_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enable asynchronous DMA request for the channel.

enumeratedValue.name: EEI_0
enumeratedValue.description: The error signal for corresponding channel does not generate an error interrupt

enumeratedValue.name: EEI_1
enumeratedValue.description: The assertion of the error signal for corresponding channel generates an error interrupt request

enumeratedValue.name: DBE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The last recorded error was a bus error on a destination write

enumeratedValue.name: SBE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The last recorded error was a bus error on a source read

enumeratedValue.name: SGE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The last recorded error was a configuration error detected in the TCDn_DLASTSGA field. This field is checked at the beginning of a scatter/gather operation after major loop completion if TCDn_CSR[ESG] is enabled. TCDn_DLASTSGA is not on a 32 byte boundary.

enumeratedValue.name: NCE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The last recorded error was a configuration error detected in the TCDn_NBYTES or TCDn_CITER fields. TCDn_NBYTES is not a multiple of TCDn_ATTR[SSIZE] and TCDn_ATTR[DSIZE], or TCDn_CITER[CITER] is equal to zero, or TCDn_CITER[ELINK] is not equal to TCDn_BITER[ELINK]

enumeratedValue.name: DOE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The last recorded error was a configuration error detected in the TCDn_DOFF field. TCDn_DOFF is inconsistent with TCDn_ATTR[DSIZE].

enumeratedValue.name: DAE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The last recorded error was a configuration error detected in the TCDn_DADDR field. TCDn_DADDR is inconsistent with TCDn_ATTR[DSIZE].

enumeratedValue.name: SOE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The last recorded error was a configuration error detected in the TCDn_SOFF field. TCDn_SOFF is inconsistent with TCDn_ATTR[SSIZE].

enumeratedValue.name: SAE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The last recorded error was a configuration error detected in the TCDn_SADDR field. TCDn_SADDR is inconsistent with TCDn_ATTR[SSIZE].

enumeratedValue.name: ERR_0
enumeratedValue.description: An error in this channel has not occurred

enumeratedValue.name: ERR_1
enumeratedValue.description: An error in this channel has occurred

enumeratedValue.name: INT_0
enumeratedValue.description: The interrupt request for corresponding channel is cleared

enumeratedValue.name: INT_1
enumeratedValue.description: The interrupt request for corresponding channel is active

enumeratedValue.name: PAL_0
enumeratedValue.description: User protection level for DMA transfers

enumeratedValue.name: PAL_1
enumeratedValue.description: Privileged protection level for DMA transfers

enumeratedValue.name: DPA_0
enumeratedValue.description: The channel can suspend a lower priority channel.

enumeratedValue.name: DPA_1
enumeratedValue.description: The channel cannot suspend any other channel, regardless of channel priority.

enumeratedValue.name: ECP_0
enumeratedValue.description: The channel cannot be suspended by a higher priority channel's service request.

enumeratedValue.name: ECP_1
enumeratedValue.description: The channel can be temporarily suspended by the service request of a higher priority channel.

enumeratedValue.name: SMOD_0
enumeratedValue.description: Source address modulo feature is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: SMOD_1
enumeratedValue.description: Source address modulo feature is enabled for any non-zero value [1-31]

enumeratedValue.name: INTMAJOR_1
enumeratedValue.description: The end-of-major loop interrupt is enabled.

field.name: INTHALF
field.description: Enable an interrupt when major counter is half complete.

enumeratedValue.name: DREQ_1
enumeratedValue.description: Clear the ERQ bit upon major loop completion, thus disabling hardware service requests.

enumeratedValue.name: ESG_0
enumeratedValue.description: The current channel's TCD is normal format.

enumeratedValue.name: ESG_1
enumeratedValue.description: The current channel's TCD specifies a scatter gather format. The DLASTSGA field provides a memory pointer to the next TCD to be loaded into this channel after the major loop completes its execution.

field.name: MAJORELINK
field.description: Enable channel-to-channel linking on major loop complete

enumeratedValue.name: EEOP_1
enumeratedValue.description: The end-of-packet hardware input signal is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ESDA_0
enumeratedValue.description: The store destination address to system memory operation is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ESDA_1
enumeratedValue.description: The store destination address to system memory operation is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: BWC_2
enumeratedValue.description: eDMA engine stalls for 4 cycles after each R/W.

enumeratedValue.name: BWC_3
enumeratedValue.description: eDMA engine stalls for 8 cycles after each R/W.

field.name: ELINK

enumeratedValue.name: ERQ_0
enumeratedValue.description: The DMA hardware request signal for the corresponding channel is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ERQ_1
enumeratedValue.description: The DMA hardware request signal for the corresponding channel is enabled.

field.name: EARQ
field.description: Enable Asynchronous DMA Request in stop mode for channel

enumeratedValue.name: EARQ_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disable asynchronous DMA request for the channel.

enumeratedValue.name: EARQ_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enable asynchronous DMA request for the channel.

enumeratedValue.name: EEI_0
enumeratedValue.description: The error signal for corresponding channel does not generate an error interrupt

enumeratedValue.name: EEI_1
enumeratedValue.description: The assertion of the error signal for corresponding channel generates an error interrupt request

enumeratedValue.name: DBE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The last recorded error was a bus error on a destination write

enumeratedValue.name: SBE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The last recorded error was a bus error on a source read

enumeratedValue.name: SGE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The last recorded error was a configuration error detected in the TCDn_DLASTSGA field. This field is checked at the beginning of a scatter/gather operation after major loop completion if TCDn_CSR[ESG] is enabled. TCDn_DLASTSGA is not on a 32 byte boundary.

enumeratedValue.name: NCE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The last recorded error was a configuration error detected in the TCDn_NBYTES or TCDn_CITER fields. TCDn_NBYTES is not a multiple of TCDn_ATTR[SSIZE] and TCDn_ATTR[DSIZE], or TCDn_CITER[CITER] is equal to zero, or TCDn_CITER[ELINK] is not equal to TCDn_BITER[ELINK]

enumeratedValue.name: DOE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The last recorded error was a configuration error detected in the TCDn_DOFF field. TCDn_DOFF is inconsistent with TCDn_ATTR[DSIZE].

enumeratedValue.name: DAE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The last recorded error was a configuration error detected in the TCDn_DADDR field. TCDn_DADDR is inconsistent with TCDn_ATTR[DSIZE].

enumeratedValue.name: SOE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The last recorded error was a configuration error detected in the TCDn_SOFF field. TCDn_SOFF is inconsistent with TCDn_ATTR[SSIZE].

enumeratedValue.name: SAE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The last recorded error was a configuration error detected in the TCDn_SADDR field. TCDn_SADDR is inconsistent with TCDn_ATTR[SSIZE].

enumeratedValue.name: ERR_0
enumeratedValue.description: An error in this channel has not occurred

enumeratedValue.name: ERR_1
enumeratedValue.description: An error in this channel has occurred

enumeratedValue.name: INT_0
enumeratedValue.description: The interrupt request for corresponding channel is cleared

enumeratedValue.name: INT_1
enumeratedValue.description: The interrupt request for corresponding channel is active

enumeratedValue.name: PAL_0
enumeratedValue.description: User protection level for DMA transfers

enumeratedValue.name: PAL_1
enumeratedValue.description: Privileged protection level for DMA transfers

enumeratedValue.name: DPA_0
enumeratedValue.description: The channel can suspend a lower priority channel.

enumeratedValue.name: DPA_1
enumeratedValue.description: The channel cannot suspend any other channel, regardless of channel priority.

enumeratedValue.name: ECP_0
enumeratedValue.description: The channel cannot be suspended by a higher priority channel's service request.

enumeratedValue.name: ECP_1
enumeratedValue.description: The channel can be temporarily suspended by the service request of a higher priority channel.

enumeratedValue.name: SMOD_0
enumeratedValue.description: Source address modulo feature is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: SMOD_1
enumeratedValue.description: Source address modulo feature is enabled for any non-zero value [1-31]

enumeratedValue.name: FEATURE_4
enumeratedValue.description: Standard feature set supporting a 32-bit shift register.

enumeratedValue.name: DOZEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: LPSPI module is enabled in Doze mode

enumeratedValue.name: DOZEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: LPSPI module is disabled in Doze mode

enumeratedValue.name: DBGEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: LPSPI module is disabled in debug mode

enumeratedValue.name: DBGEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: LPSPI module is enabled in debug mode

enumeratedValue.name: WCF_0
enumeratedValue.description: Transfer of a received word has not yet completed

enumeratedValue.name: WCF_1
enumeratedValue.description: Transfer of a received word has completed

enumeratedValue.name: TEF_0
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit FIFO underrun has not occurred

enumeratedValue.name: HRSEL_0
enumeratedValue.description: Host request input is the LPSPI_HREQ pin

enumeratedValue.name: HRSEL_1
enumeratedValue.description: Host request input is the input trigger

enumeratedValue.name: RDMO_0
enumeratedValue.description: Received data is stored in the receive FIFO as in normal operations

enumeratedValue.name: RDMO_1
enumeratedValue.description: Received data is discarded unless the Data Match Flag (DMF) is set

enumeratedValue.name: SAMPLE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Input data is sampled on SCK edge

enumeratedValue.name: SAMPLE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Input data is sampled on delayed SCK edge

enumeratedValue.name: NOSTALL_0
enumeratedValue.description: Transfers will stall when the transmit FIFO is empty or the receive FIFO is full

enumeratedValue.name: NOSTALL_1
enumeratedValue.description: Transfers will not stall, allowing transmit FIFO underruns or receive FIFO overruns to occur

enumeratedValue.name: PCSPOL_0
enumeratedValue.description: The Peripheral Chip Select pin PCSx is active low

enumeratedValue.name: PCSPOL_1
enumeratedValue.description: The Peripheral Chip Select pin PCSx is active high

enumeratedValue.name: MATCFG_2
enumeratedValue.description: 010b - Match is enabled, if 1st data word equals MATCH0 OR MATCH1, i.e., (1st data word = MATCH0 + MATCH1)

enumeratedValue.name: MATCFG_3
enumeratedValue.description: 011b - Match is enabled, if any data word equals MATCH0 OR MATCH1, i.e., (any data word = MATCH0 + MATCH1)

enumeratedValue.name: MATCFG_4
enumeratedValue.description: 100b - Match is enabled, if 1st data word equals MATCH0 AND 2nd data word equals MATCH1, i.e., [(1st data word = MATCH0) * (2nd data word = MATCH1)]

enumeratedValue.name: MATCFG_5
enumeratedValue.description: 101b - Match is enabled, if any data word equals MATCH0 AND the next data word equals MATCH1, i.e., [(any data word = MATCH0) * (next data word = MATCH1)]

enumeratedValue.name: MATCFG_6
enumeratedValue.description: 110b - Match is enabled, if (1st data word AND MATCH1) equals (MATCH0 AND MATCH1), i.e., [(1st data word * MATCH1) = (MATCH0 * MATCH1)]

enumeratedValue.name: MATCFG_7
enumeratedValue.description: 111b - Match is enabled, if (any data word AND MATCH1) equals (MATCH0 AND MATCH1), i.e., [(any data word * MATCH1) = (MATCH0 * MATCH1)]

enumeratedValue.name: PINCFG_0
enumeratedValue.description: SIN is used for input data and SOUT is used for output data

enumeratedValue.name: PINCFG_1
enumeratedValue.description: SIN is used for both input and output data

enumeratedValue.name: PINCFG_2
enumeratedValue.description: SOUT is used for both input and output data

enumeratedValue.name: PINCFG_3
enumeratedValue.description: SOUT is used for input data and SIN is used for output data

enumeratedValue.name: OUTCFG_0
enumeratedValue.description: Output data retains last value when chip select is negated

enumeratedValue.name: OUTCFG_1
enumeratedValue.description: Output data is tristated when chip select is negated

enumeratedValue.name: CONTC_0
enumeratedValue.description: Command word for start of new transfer

enumeratedValue.name: CPHA_0
enumeratedValue.description: Data is captured on the leading edge of SCK and changed on the following edge of SCK

enumeratedValue.name: CPHA_1
enumeratedValue.description: Data is changed on the leading edge of SCK and captured on the following edge of SCK

enumeratedValue.name: CPOL_0
enumeratedValue.description: The inactive state value of SCK is low

enumeratedValue.name: CPOL_1
enumeratedValue.description: The inactive state value of SCK is high

enumeratedValue.name: SOF_0
enumeratedValue.description: Subsequent data word received after LPSPI_PCS assertion

enumeratedValue.name: SOF_1
enumeratedValue.description: First data word received after LPSPI_PCS assertion

enumeratedValue.name: DIVISOR_VALUE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Invalid. As per ISO 7816 specification, minimum value of F/D is 5

enumeratedValue.name: DIVISOR_VALUE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Invalid. As per ISO 7816 specification, minimum value of F/D is 5

enumeratedValue.name: DIVISOR_VALUE_2
enumeratedValue.description: Invalid. As per ISO 7816 specification, minimum value of F/D is 5

enumeratedValue.name: DIVISOR_VALUE_3
enumeratedValue.description: Invalid. As per ISO 7816 specification, minimum value of F/D is 5

enumeratedValue.name: DIVISOR_VALUE_4
enumeratedValue.description: Invalid. As per ISO 7816 specification, minimum value of F/D is 5

enumeratedValue.name: DIVISOR_VALUE_372
enumeratedValue.description: Divisor value for F = 372 and D = 1 (default)

enumeratedValue.name: ONACK_0
enumeratedValue.description: NACK generation on overrun is disabled (default)

enumeratedValue.name: ONACK_1
enumeratedValue.description: NACK generation on overrun is enabled

enumeratedValue.name: FLSH_RX_1
enumeratedValue.description: EMV SIM Receiver held in Reset

enumeratedValue.name: FLSH_TX_1
enumeratedValue.description: EMV SIM Transmitter held in Reset

enumeratedValue.name: KILL_CLOCKS_1
enumeratedValue.description: EMV SIM input clock is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: DOZE_EN_0
enumeratedValue.description: DOZE instruction will gate all internal EMV SIM clocks as well as the Smart Card clock when the transmit FIFO is empty (default)

enumeratedValue.name: DOZE_EN_1
enumeratedValue.description: DOZE instruction has no effect on EMV SIM module

enumeratedValue.name: STOP_EN_0
enumeratedValue.description: STOP instruction shuts down all EMV SIM clocks (default)

enumeratedValue.name: STOP_EN_1
enumeratedValue.description: STOP instruction shuts down all clocks except for the Smart Card Clock (SCK) (clock provided to Smart Card)

enumeratedValue.name: RCVR_11_0
enumeratedValue.description: Receiver configured for 12 ETU operation mode (default)

enumeratedValue.name: RCVR_11_1
enumeratedValue.description: Receiver configured for 11 ETU operation mode

enumeratedValue.name: RX_DMA_EN_0
enumeratedValue.description: No DMA Read Request asserted for Receiver (default)

enumeratedValue.name: RX_DMA_EN_1
enumeratedValue.description: DMA Read Request asserted for Receiver

enumeratedValue.name: TX_DMA_EN_0
enumeratedValue.description: No DMA Write Request asserted for Transmitter (default)

enumeratedValue.name: TX_DMA_EN_1
enumeratedValue.description: DMA Write Request asserted for Transmitter

field.name: INV_CRC_VAL
field.description: Invert bits in the CRC Output Value

enumeratedValue.name: INV_CRC_VAL_0
enumeratedValue.description: Bits in CRC Output value will not be inverted.

enumeratedValue.name: INV_CRC_VAL_1
enumeratedValue.description: Bits in CRC Output value will be inverted. (default)

field.name: CRC_OUT_FLIP
field.description: CRC Output Value Bit Reversal or Flip

enumeratedValue.name: CRC_OUT_FLIP_0
enumeratedValue.description: Bits within the CRC output bytes will not be reversed i.e. 15:0 will remain 15:0 (default)

enumeratedValue.name: CRC_OUT_FLIP_1
enumeratedValue.description: Bits within the CRC output bytes will be reversed i.e. 15:0 will become {8:15,0:7}

field.name: CRC_IN_FLIP
field.description: CRC Input Byte's Bit Reversal or Flip Control

enumeratedValue.name: CRC_IN_FLIP_0
enumeratedValue.description: Bits in the input byte will not be reversed (i.e. 7:0 will remain 7:0) before the CRC calculation (default)

enumeratedValue.name: CRC_IN_FLIP_1
enumeratedValue.description: Bits in the input byte will be reversed (i.e. 7:0 will become 0:7) before CRC calculation

enumeratedValue.name: CWT_EN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Character Wait time Counter is disabled (default)

enumeratedValue.name: CWT_EN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Character Wait time counter is enabled

enumeratedValue.name: XMT_CRC_LRC_0
enumeratedValue.description: No CRC or LRC value is transmitted (default)

enumeratedValue.name: XMT_CRC_LRC_1
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit LRC or CRC info when FIFO empties (whichever is enabled)

field.name: GPCNT0_IM
field.description: General Purpose Timer 0 Timeout Interrupt Mask

field.name: CWT_ERR_IM
field.description: Character Wait Time Error Interrupt Mask

field.name: BWT_ERR_IM
field.description: Block Wait Time Error Interrupt Mask

field.name: GPCNT1_IM
field.description: General Purpose Counter 1 Timeout Interrupt Mask

enumeratedValue.name: RNCK_THD_0
enumeratedValue.description: Zero Threshold. RTE will not be set

enumeratedValue.name: TNCK_THD_0
enumeratedValue.description: TNTE will never be set; retransmission after NACK reception is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: TNCK_THD_1
enumeratedValue.description: TNTE will be set after 1 nack is received; 0 retransmissions occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: TNCK_THD_2
enumeratedValue.description: TNTE will be set after 2 nacks are received; at most 1 retransmission occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: TNCK_THD_3
enumeratedValue.description: TNTE will be set after 3 nacks are received; at most 2 retransmissions occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: TNCK_THD_15
enumeratedValue.description: TNTE will be set after 15 nacks are received; at most 14 retransmissions occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: RFO_1
enumeratedValue.description: A byte was received when the received FIFO was already full

enumeratedValue.name: RX_DATA_1
enumeratedValue.description: New byte is received ans stored in Receive FIFO

enumeratedValue.name: RDTF_0
enumeratedValue.description: Number of unread bytes in receive FIFO less than the value set by RDT[3:0] (default).

enumeratedValue.name: RDTF_1
enumeratedValue.description: Number of unread bytes in receive FIFO greater or than equal to value set by RDT[3:0].

enumeratedValue.name: LRC_OK_0
enumeratedValue.description: Current LRC value does not match remainder.

enumeratedValue.name: LRC_OK_1
enumeratedValue.description: Current calculated LRC value matches the expected result (i.e. zero).

enumeratedValue.name: CRC_OK_0
enumeratedValue.description: Current CRC value does not match remainder.

enumeratedValue.name: CRC_OK_1
enumeratedValue.description: Current calculated CRC value matches the expected result.

enumeratedValue.name: CWT_ERR_1
enumeratedValue.description: Time between two consecutive characters has exceeded the value in CHAR_WAIT.

enumeratedValue.name: RTE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Number of NACKs generated by the receiver is less than the value programmed in RTH[3:0]

enumeratedValue.name: RTE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Number of NACKs generated by the receiver is equal to the value programmed in RTH[3:0]

enumeratedValue.name: BGT_ERR_1
enumeratedValue.description: Block guard time was too small

enumeratedValue.name: TNTE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit NACK threshold has not been reached (default)

enumeratedValue.name: TNTE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit NACK threshold reached; transmitter frozen

enumeratedValue.name: TFF_0
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit FIFO Full condition has not occurred (default)

enumeratedValue.name: TFF_1
enumeratedValue.description: A Transmit FIFO Full condition has occurred

enumeratedValue.name: TDTF_0
enumeratedValue.description: Number of bytes in FIFO is greater than TDT[3:0], or bit has been cleared

enumeratedValue.name: TDTF_1
enumeratedValue.description: Number of bytes in FIFO is less than or equal to TDT[3:0] (default)

enumeratedValue.name: GPCNT0_TO_0
enumeratedValue.description: GPCNT0_VAL time not reached, or bit has been cleared. (default)

enumeratedValue.name: GPCNT0_TO_1
enumeratedValue.description: General Purpose counter has reached the GPCNT0_VAL value

enumeratedValue.name: GPCNT1_TO_0
enumeratedValue.description: GPCNT1_VAL time not reached, or bit has been cleared. (default)

enumeratedValue.name: GPCNT1_TO_1
enumeratedValue.description: General Purpose counter has reached the GPCNT1_VAL value

enumeratedValue.name: VCCENP_0
enumeratedValue.description: VCC_EN is active high. Polarity of SVCC_EN is unchanged.

enumeratedValue.name: VCCENP_1
enumeratedValue.description: VCC_EN is active low. Polarity of SVCC_EN is inverted.

enumeratedValue.name: SCSP_0
enumeratedValue.description: Clock is logic 0 when stopped by SCEN

enumeratedValue.name: SCSP_1
enumeratedValue.description: Clock is logic 1 when stopped by SCEN

enumeratedValue.name: SPD_1
enumeratedValue.description: Start Auto Powerdown or Power Down is in progress

enumeratedValue.name: TPRICTRL_0
enumeratedValue.description: If a higher priority trigger is detected during command processing, the current conversion is aborted and the new command specified by the trigger is started.

enumeratedValue.name: TPRICTRL_1
enumeratedValue.description: If a higher priority trigger is received during command processing, the current conversion is completed (including averaging iterations if enabled) and stored to the RESFIFO before the higher priority trigger/command is initiated. Note that compare until true commands can be interrupted prior to resulting in a true conversion.

enumeratedValue.name: PWREN_0
enumeratedValue.description: ADC analog circuits are only enabled while conversions are active. Performance is affected due to analog startup delays.

enumeratedValue.name: PWREN_1
enumeratedValue.description: ADC analog circuits are pre-enabled and ready to execute conversions without startup delays (at the cost of higher DC current consumption). When PWREN is set, the power up delay is enforced such that any detected trigger does not begin ADC operation until the power up delay time has passed.

enumeratedValue.description: MB6 completed transmission/reception when CAN_MCR[RFEN]=0, or Rx FIFO almost full when CAN_MCR[RFEN]=1

field.name: BUF7I
field.description: Buffer MB7 Interrupt Or "Rx FIFO Overflow"

enumeratedValue.name: BUF7I_0
enumeratedValue.description: No occurrence of MB7 completing transmission/reception when CAN_MCR[RFEN]=0, or of Rx FIFO overflow when CAN_MCR[RFEN]=1

enumeratedValue.name: BUF7I_1
enumeratedValue.description: MB7 completed transmission/reception when CAN_MCR[RFEN]=0, or Rx FIFO overflow when CAN_MCR[RFEN]=1

field.name: EACEN
field.description: Entire Frame Arbitration Field Comparison Enable For Rx Mailboxes

enumeratedValue.name: EACEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Rx Mailbox filter's IDE bit is always compared and RTR is never compared despite mask bits.

enumeratedValue.name: EACEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enables the comparison of both Rx Mailbox filter's IDE and RTR bit with their corresponding bits within the incoming frame. Mask bits do apply.

enumeratedValue.name: MRP_0
enumeratedValue.description: Matching starts from Rx FIFO and continues on Mailboxes.

enumeratedValue.name: MRP_1
enumeratedValue.description: Matching starts from Mailboxes and continues on Rx FIFO.

field.name: ERRMSK_FAST
field.description: Error Interrupt Mask for errors detected in the Data Phase of fast CAN FD frames

enumeratedValue.name: IMB_0
enumeratedValue.description: If CAN_ESR2[VPS] is asserted, the CAN_ESR2[LPTM] is not an inactive Mailbox.

enumeratedValue.name: IMB_1
enumeratedValue.description: If CAN_ESR2[VPS] is asserted, there is at least one inactive Mailbox. LPTM content is the number of the first one.

enumeratedValue.name: VPS_0
enumeratedValue.description: Contents of IMB and LPTM are invalid.

enumeratedValue.name: VPS_1
enumeratedValue.description: Contents of IMB and LPTM are valid.

field.name: TIME_STAMP
field.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

field.name: DLC
field.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

field.name: RTR
field.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

field.name: IDE
field.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

field.name: SRR
field.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

field.name: CODE
field.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

field.name: ESI
field.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

field.name: BRS
field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.name: EXT
field.description: Contains extended (LOW word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: STD
field.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: PRIO
field.description: Local priority. This 3-bit fieldis only used when LPRIO_EN bit is set in MCR and it only makes sense for Tx buffers. These bits are not transmitted. They are appended to the regular ID to define the transmission priority.

field.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

field.name: ESI
field.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

field.name: BRS
field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.name: EXT
field.description: Contains extended (LOW word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: STD
field.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: PRIO
field.description: Local priority. This 3-bit fieldis only used when LPRIO_EN bit is set in MCR and it only makes sense for Tx buffers. These bits are not transmitted. They are appended to the regular ID to define the transmission priority.

field.name: TIME_STAMP
field.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

field.name: DLC
field.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

field.name: RTR
field.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

field.name: IDE
field.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

field.name: TIME_STAMP
field.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

field.name: DLC
field.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

field.name: RTR
field.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

field.name: IDE
field.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

field.name: SRR
field.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

field.name: CODE
field.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

field.name: ESI
field.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

field.name: BRS
field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.name: EXT
field.description: Contains extended (LOW word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: STD
field.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: BRS
field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.name: EXT
field.description: Contains extended (LOW word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: STD
field.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: PRIO
field.description: Local priority. This 3-bit fieldis only used when LPRIO_EN bit is set in MCR and it only makes sense for Tx buffers. These bits are not transmitted. They are appended to the regular ID to define the transmission priority.

field.name: TIME_STAMP
field.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

field.name: DLC
field.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

field.name: RTR
field.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

field.name: IDE
field.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

field.name: SRR
field.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

field.name: CODE
field.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

field.name: MBDSR0
field.description: Message Buffer Data Size for Region 0

enumeratedValue.name: FDRATE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit a frame in nominal rate. The BRS bit in the Tx MB has no effect.

enumeratedValue.name: FDRATE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit a frame with bit rate switching if the BRS bit in the Tx MB is recessive.

enumeratedValue.name: ECX_1
enumeratedValue.description: Cancel the remaining data transfer in the same fashion as the CX bit. Stop the executing channel and force the minor loop to finish. The cancel takes effect after the last write of the current read/write sequence. The ECX bit clears itself after the cancel is honored. In addition to cancelling the transfer, ECX treats the cancel as an error condition, thus updating the Error Status register (DMAx_ES) and generating an optional error interrupt.

enumeratedValue.name: CX_1
enumeratedValue.description: Cancel the remaining data transfer. Stop the executing channel and force the minor loop to finish. The cancel takes effect after the last write of the current read/write sequence. The CX bit clears itself after the cancel has been honored. This cancel retires the channel normally as if the minor loop was completed.

enumeratedValue.description: The current channel's TCD is normal format.

enumeratedValue.name: ESG_1
enumeratedValue.description: The current channel's TCD specifies a scatter gather format. The DLASTSGA field provides a memory pointer to the next TCD to be loaded into this channel after the major loop completes its execution.

field.name: MAJORELINK
field.description: Enable channel-to-channel linking on major loop complete

enumeratedValue.name: EEOP_1
enumeratedValue.description: The end-of-packet hardware input signal is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ESDA_0
enumeratedValue.description: The store destination address to system memory operation is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ESDA_1
enumeratedValue.description: The store destination address to system memory operation is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: BWC_2
enumeratedValue.description: eDMA engine stalls for 4 cycles after each R/W.

enumeratedValue.name: BWC_3
enumeratedValue.description: eDMA engine stalls for 8 cycles after each R/W.

register.name: TCD4_BITER_ELINKNO
register.description: TCD Beginning Major Loop Count (Minor Loop Channel Linking Disabled)

field.name: ELINK
field.description: Enables channel-to-channel linking on minor loop complete

register.name: TCD4_BITER_ELINKYES
register.description: TCD Beginning Major Loop Count (Minor Loop Channel Linking Enabled)

field.name: ELINK
field.description: Enables channel-to-channel linking on minor loop complete

enumeratedValue.name: START_0
enumeratedValue.description: Do not start the sequence. Writes of this value have no effect.

enumeratedValue.name: START_1
enumeratedValue.description: Initiate the charger detection sequence. If the sequence is already running, writes of this value have no effect.

enumeratedValue.name: SR_0
enumeratedValue.description: Do not perform a software reset.

field.name: CLOCK_UNIT
field.description: Unit of Measurement Encoding for Clock Speed

field.name: CLOCK_SPEED
field.description: Numerical Value of Clock Speed in Binary

enumeratedValue.name: SEQ_RES_1
enumeratedValue.description: Attached to an SDP. Must comply with USB 2.0 by drawing only 2.5 mA (max) until connected.

enumeratedValue.name: SEQ_RES_2
enumeratedValue.description: Attached to a charging port. The exact meaning depends on bit 18 (value 0: Attached to either a CDP or a DCP. The charger type detection has not completed. value 1: Attached to a CDP. The charger type detection has completed.)

enumeratedValue.name: SEQ_STAT_0
enumeratedValue.description: The module is either not enabled, or the module is enabled but the data pins have not yet been detected.

enumeratedValue.name: SEQ_STAT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Data pin contact detection is complete.

enumeratedValue.name: ERR_1
enumeratedValue.description: Error in the detection sequence. See the SEQ_STAT field to determine the phase in which the error occurred.

enumeratedValue.name: TO_0
enumeratedValue.description: The detection sequence has not been running for over 1 s.

enumeratedValue.name: TO_1
enumeratedValue.description: It has been over 1 s since the data pin contact was detected and debounced.

enumeratedValue.name: PS_0
enumeratedValue.description: No overrides. Same behavior as functional mode.

enumeratedValue.name: PS_1
enumeratedValue.description: usbdcd_en and usbdcd_data_cont_det_en signals to analog block are forced high. Enables IDP_SRC and RDM_DWN.

enumeratedValue.name: PS_2
enumeratedValue.description: usbdcd_en and usbdcd_chg_det_en signals to analog block are forced high. Enables VDP_SRC and IDM_SINK.

enumeratedValue.name: PS_3
enumeratedValue.description: For USB Battery Charging Specification Revision 1.2 usbdcd_en and usbdcd_dcp_det_en signals to analog block are forced high. Enables VDM_SRC and IDP_SINK.

enumeratedValue.name: DMIR_0
enumeratedValue.description: D- voltage is not within the defined range.

enumeratedValue.name: DMIR_1
enumeratedValue.description: D- voltage is within the defined range.

enumeratedValue.name: DPIR_0
enumeratedValue.description: D+ voltage is not within the defined range.

enumeratedValue.name: DPIR_1
enumeratedValue.description: D+ voltage is within the defined range.

field.name: TDCD_DBNC
field.description: Time Period to Debounce D+ Signal

field.name: CHECK_DM
field.description: Time Before Check of D- Line

field.name: TVDPSRC_CON
field.description: Time Period Before Enabling D+ Pullup

field.name: DEV_BUS_REQ
field.description: Request the bus for Device mode. It will set DEV_ACTIVE bit is OTGSTS

field.name: HOST_BUS_REQ
field.description: Request the bus for Host mode. It will set HOST_ACTIVE bit is OTGSTS

field.name: OTG_EN
field.description: Enable OTG mode. It will set OTG_IS_ENABLED bit is OTGSTS

field.name: OTG_DIS
field.description: Disable OTG mode. It will clear OTG_IS_ENABLED bit is OTGSTS

field.name: A_DEV_EN
field.description: Configure OTG as A-Device. It is only valid if OTG mode is enabled. This bit should be set in the same time when OTG_EN

field.name: A_DEV_DIS
field.description: Configure OTG as B-Device. It is only valid if OTG mode is enabled. This bit should be set in the same time when OTG_EN

field.name: DEV_SESS_VLD_USE_SET
field.description: Device should use b_sess_vld as vbus valid indication. This bit should be set in the same time when DEV_BUS_REQ

field.name: DEV_SESS_VLD_USE_CLR
field.description: Device should use a_vbus_vld as vbus valid indication. This bit should be set in the same time when DEV_BUS_REQ

field.name: DEV_BUS_DROP
field.description: Drop the bus for Device mode. This bit should be set when Device mode is no longer needed. It will clear DEV_ACTIVE bit is OTGSTS

field.name: HOST_BUS_DROP
field.description: Drop the bus for Host mode. This bit should be set when Host mode is no longer needed. It will clear HOST_ACTIVE bit is OTGSTS

field.name: DIS_VBUS_DROP
field.description: Do not disable vbus while bus is dropped. This bit is valid only if DEV_BUS_DROP or HOST_BUS_DROP are set

field.name: DEV_DEVEN_FORCE_SET
field.description: Set forcing Device DEVEN bit to 1. This bit may be set while switching from Host to Device mode takes place. Setting this bit should be done in the same time when Device mode is activated (DEV_BUS_REQ). Setting this bit causes DEV_DEVEN_FORCE bit in OTGSTS set

field.name: DEV_DEVEN_FORCE_CLR
field.description: Clear forcing Device DEVEN bit to 1. Setting this bit causes DEV_DEVEN_FORCE bit in OTGSTS clear

field.name: H_WRST_FOR_SWAP_SET
field.description: Upcoming Warm Reset will be generated for Role Swapping. This bit should be set before Warm Reset for Role Swap is generated on the Port

field.name: H_WRST_FOR_SWAP_CLR
field.description: Upcoming Warm Reset will not be generated for Role Swapping. This bit should be set after Warm Reset for Role Swap is generated on the Port

field.name: D_WRST_FOR_SWAP_SET
field.description: Upcoming Warm Reset will be received for Role Swapping. This bit should be set before Warm Reset for Role Swap is received on the Port

field.name: D_WRST_FOR_SWAP_CLR
field.description: Upcoming received Warm Reset should not be treated as Role Swapping indication. This bit should be set after Warm Reset for Role Swap is received on the Port

field.name: SS_HOST_DISABLED_SET
field.description: Disable SuperSpeed host functionality. Can be used only if Host mode is not active

field.name: SS_PERIPH_DISABLED_SET
field.description: Disable SuperSpeed peripheral device functionality. Can be used only if Peripheral mode is not active

field.name: A_SET_B_HNP_EN_SET
field.description: This bit should be written if SetFeature(b_hnp_enable) has been sent

field.name: A_SET_B_HNP_EN_CLR
field.description: This bit should be written if upcoming USB 2.0 bus suspend should not cause Role Swap

field.name: B_HNP_EN_SET
field.description: This bit should be written if SetFeature(b_hnp_enable) has been accepted

field.name: B_HNP_EN_CLR
field.description: This bit should be written if software wants to clear b_hnp_enable

field.name: OTG2_SWITCH_TO_PERIPH
field.description: Switch to Peripheral mode when operating at USB 2.0

field.name: DEV_VBUS_DEB_SHORT_SET
field.description: Enable forcing Device short VBUS debounce time. This bit should be set while switching from Host to Device mode takes place. Setting this bit should be done in the same time when Device mode is activated (DEV_BUS_REQ). Setting this bit causes DEV_VBUS_DEB_SHORT bit in OTGSTS set

field.name: DEV_VBUS_DEB_SHORT_CLR
field.description: Disable forcing Device short VBUS debounce time. Setting this bit causes DEV_VBUS_DEB_SHORT bit in OTGSTS clear

field.name: ID_VALUE
field.description: Current value of the ID pin. It is only valid when idpullup in OTGCTRL1_TYPE register is set to '1'. ID_VALUE must be valid within 50ms after idpullup is set to '1'

field.name: DEV_ACTIVE
field.description: Device mode is active. NOTE: It is possible that Device is in inactive state (even turned off) while DEV_ACTIVE is 1

field.name: HOST_ACTIVE
field.description: Device mode is active. NOTE: It is possible that Host is in inactive state (even turned off) while HOST_ACTIVE is 1

field.name: OTG_MODE
field.description: OTG mode: 0 - A-Device 1 - B-Device Valid only if OTG_IS_ENABLED is 1

field.name: SS_HOST_DISABLED
field.description: SuperSpeed host functionality is disabled. Port will be operating at USB 2.0 speed

field.name: SS_PERIPH_DISABLED
field.description: SuperSpeed device functionality is disabled. Port will be operating at USB 2.0 speed

field.name: DEV_VBUS_DEB_SHORT
field.description: Device forcing short VBUS decounce is enabled

field.name: DEV_SESS_VLD_USE
field.description: Device mode vbus valid indication: 0: a_vbus_vld is used as vbus valid 1: b_sess_vld is used as vbus valid

field.name: OTG_NRDY
field.description: OTG Controller not ready. Software shall not read nor write any register except OTGISTS if this bit is set

field.name: STRAP
field.description: Value of the strap pins. 000 - no default configuration 010 - Controller initiall configured as Host 100 - Controller initially configured as Device other - Reserved (might be used for Type-C)

field.name: H_WRST_FOR_SWAP
field.description: Upcoming Warm Reset will be generated for Role Swapping from Host to Peripheral

field.name: DEV_DEVEN_FORCE
field.description: Device forcing DEVEN bit is enabled

field.name: D_WRST_FOR_SWAP
field.description: Upcoming Warm Reset will be received for Role Swapping from Peripheral to Host

field.name: SRP_INITIAL_CONDITION_MET
field.description: SRP initial condition are met. OTG B-device software should issue SRP puluse onli if this bit is set

field.name: SRP_DET_NOT_COMPLIANT_DEV
field.description: OTG A-device detected not compilant device. If this bit is set then OTG A-device should disable SRP detection until not compilant device is disconnected (SRP_NOT_COMP_DEV_REMOVED_INT)

field.name: A_SET_B_HNP_EN
field.description: SetFeature(b_hnp_enable) has been sent and is valid

field.name: XHC_READY
field.description: Host mode is turned on; registers in CDNSXHCI AUX domain are accessible through APB

field.name: DEV_READY
field.description: Device mode is turned on; registers in USBSS-DEV domain are accessible through APB

field.name: DEV_OTG_STATE
field.description: Current state of the OTG Device FSM

field.name: HOST_OTG_STATE
field.description: Current state of the OTG Host FSM

field.name: APB_AXI_CTRL
field.description: Current state of the ABP/AXI mux selector

field.name: PIPE_CTRL
field.description: Current state of the USB3 PIPE mux selector

field.name: UTMI_CTRL
field.description: Current state of the USB2 UTMI mux selector

enumeratedValue.name: UTMI_CTRL_0
enumeratedValue.description: Both modes off, and OTG takes control over UTMI (SRP,BC)

field.name: DEV_POWER_STATE
field.description: Current state of the Device power controlling FSM

field.name: HOST_POWER_STATE
field.description: Current state of the Host power controlling FSM

field.name: PHY_REFCLK_REQ
field.description: Value of the phy_refclk_req signal from the PHY Reference Clock Control interface

field.name: PHY_REFCLK_1PCT_VALID
field.description: Value of the phy_refclk_1pct_valid signal from the PHY Reference Clock Control interface

field.name: PHY_REFCLK_VALID
field.description: Value of the phy_refclk_valid signal from the PHY Reference Clock Control interface

field.name: P3_TO_REFCLK_REQ
field.description: Time in stb_clk_predft clock period units within which the module won't be requesting for Reference Clock to be off after USB 3.0 PHY powerdown changes to P3

field.name: SUSPEND_TO_REFCLK_REQ
field.description: Time in stb_clk_predft clock period units within which the module won't be requesting for Reference Clock to be off after USB 2.0 PHY is requested to enter suspend (L2) state

field.name: OTG_STB_CLK_SWITCH_EN
field.description: Allow PHY Reference Clock sour to be either low frequency of turned-off when both modes (Host/Device) are disabled

field.name: VBUS_ON_FAILED_INT_EN
field.description: Enabling Vbus by A-Device has failed interrupt enable

field.name: SENSE_RISE_INT_EN
field.description: ADP sense comparator rise detected interrupt enable

field.name: PROBE_RISE_INT_EN
field.description: ADP probe comparator rise detected interrupt enable

field.name: TA_AIDL_BDIS_TMOUT_INT_EN
field.description: No response from B-Device for HNP interrupt enable

field.name: TA_BIDL_ADIS_TMOUT_INT_EN
field.description: No activity from B-Device timeout interrupt enable

field.name: SRP_DET_INT_EN
field.description: SRP pulse detected interrupt enable. NOTE: SRP detection can be enabled only if core is enabled to work as a A-device (OTGSTS.OTG_MODE=0)

field.name: SRP_NOT_COMP_DEV_REMOVED_INT_EN
field.description: Non cmpliant device disconnect interrupt enable

field.name: SRP_FAIL_INT_EN
field.description: No response from SRP from A-Device interrupt enable

field.name: TB_ASE0_BRST_TMOUT_INT_EN
field.description: No response from A-Device to HNP interrupt enable

field.name: TB_AIDL_BDIS_MIN_TMOUT_INT_EN
field.description: The bus has been in Idle state for the required time during HNP interrupt enable

field.name: H_POLL_ENTRY_INT_EN
field.description: Host Polling state entry interrupt enable

field.name: H_WRST_GEN_CMPL_INT_EN
field.description: Host Warm Reset generation completed interrupt enable

field.name: RID_FLOAT_FALL_INT_EN
field.description: RID floating comparator detect interrupt enable

field.name: RID_FLOAT_RISE_INT_EN
field.description: RID floating comparator rise detect interrupt enable

field.name: RID_GND_RISE_INT_EN
field.description: RID GND comparator rise detect interrupt enable

field.name: RID_C_RISE_INT_EN
field.description: RID C comparator rise detect interrupt enable

field.name: RID_B_RISE_INT_EN
field.description: RID B comparator rise detect interrupt enable

field.name: RID_A_RISE_INT_EN
field.description: RID A comparator rise detect interrupt enable

field.name: DM_VDAT_REF_RISE_INT_EN
field.description: DM VDAT comparator rise detect interrupt enable

field.name: DP_VDAT_REF_RISE_INT_EN
field.description: DP VDAT comparator rise detect interrupt enable

field.name: DCD_COMP_RISE_INT_EN
field.description: DCD comparator rise detect interrupt enable

field.name: DCD_COMP_FALL_INT_EN
field.description: DCD comparator fall detect interrupt enable

field.name: DM_VLGC_COMP_RISE_INT_EN
field.description: DM VLGC comparator rise detect interrupt enable

field.name: VBUS_ON_FAILED_INT
field.description: Enabling Vbus by A-Device has failed. This bit should be cleared before enabling subsequent connection as host

field.name: SENSE_RISE_INT
field.description: ADP sense comparator rise detected interrupt

field.name: PROBE_RISE_INT
field.description: ADP probe comparator rise detected interrupt

field.name: ADP_PROBE_COMPLETED_INT
field.description: ADP completed. Status is reported in OTGADPSTS

field.name: TA_AIDL_BDIS_TMOUT_INT
field.description: No response from B-Device for HNP interrupt

field.name: TA_BIDL_ADIS_TMOUT_INT
field.description: No activity from B-Device timeout interrupt

field.name: SRP_NOT_COMP_DEV_REMOVED_INT
field.description: Not cmpliant device disconnect detect interrupt

field.name: SRP_FAIL_INT
field.description: No response from SRP from A-Device interrupt

field.name: TB_ASE0_BRST_TMOUT_INT
field.description: No response from A-Device to HNP interrupt

field.name: TB_AIDL_BDIS_MIN_TMOUT_INT
field.description: The bus has been in Idle state for the required time during HNP interrupt

field.name: H_WRST_GEN_CMPL_INT
field.description: Host Warm Reset generation completed interrupt

field.name: RID_FLOAT_RISE_INT
field.description: RID floating comparator rise detect interrupt

field.name: RID_GND_RISE_INT
field.description: RID GND comparator rise detect interrupt

field.name: RID_C_RISE_INT
field.description: RID C comparator rise detect interrupt

field.name: RID_B_RISE_INT
field.description: RID B comparator rise detect interrupt

field.name: RID_A_RISE_INT
field.description: RID A comparator rise detect interrupt

field.name: DM_VDAT_REF_RISE_INT
field.description: DM VDAT comparator rise detect interrupt

field.name: DP_VDAT_REF_RISE_INT
field.description: DP VDAT comparator rise detect interrupt

field.name: DM_VLGC_COMP_RISE_INT
field.description: DM VLGC comparator rise detect interrupt

field.name: CLK_FREQ_MHZ
field.description: CLK_FREQ_MHZ defines how many cycles are needed to determine 1 us clock base for fast clock Example: Let's say that fast clock frequency is 12MHz. With CLK_FREQ_MHZ set to 12 time base would be 12 cycles of 12Mhz clock which gives 1 us

field.name: CLK_FREQ_KHZ
field.description: CLK_FREQ_KHZ defines how many cycles are needed to determine 1 ms clock base for stb_clk_predft. Example: Let's say that stb_clk_predft frequency is 32kHz. With CLK_FREQ_KHZ set to 32 time base would be 32 cycles of 32khz clock which gives 1 ms

field.name: TIMEOUT_VALUE
field.description: Timeout value for timer. Valid only if TIMER_WRITE is 1

enumeratedValue.name: TIMEOUT_UNITS_0
enumeratedValue.description: hundreds of microseconds (valid only if otg controller clock is in MHz range)

enumeratedValue.name: TIMEOUT_UNITS_3
enumeratedValue.description: hundreds of milliseconds, Valid only if TIMER_WRITE is 1

field.name: TIMER_WRITE
field.description: Timer value and units write strobe

field.name: SRP_SUPPORT
field.description: SRP support. 0 - SRP not supported 1 - SRP supported

field.name: HNP_SUPPORT
field.description: HNP support. 0 - HNP not supported 1 - HNP supported

field.name: ADP_SUPPORT
field.description: ADP support. 0 - ADP not supported 1 - ADP supported

field.name: BC_SUPPORT
field.description: BC Support (Battery Charging specification rev 1.2). 0 - BC not supported 1 - BC supported

field.name: RSP_SUPPORT
field.description: RSP support. 0 - RSP not supported 1 - RSP supported

field.name: OTG_CFG_FAST_SIMS
field.description: Debug Feature. This bit is for simulation modes only. It enables reductions to OTG timings. '0': Normal timings '1': Enable fast simulation timing modes This bit should be written '0' in normal operation

register.name: OTGANASTS
register.description: OTG Attach Detection Protocol BC Status

field.name: dp_vdat_ref_comp_sts
field.description: 1: DP > VDAT_REF Detected 0: DP < VDAT_REF Detected Note: This status shall be re-used from the single ended receiver output of D+ whenever dp_vdat_ref_comp_en is '1'

field.name: dm_vdat_ref_comp_sts
field.description: 1: DM > VDAT_REF Detected 0: DM < VDAT_REF Detected Note: This status shall be re-used from the single ended receiver output of D- whenever dm_vdat_ref_comp_en is '1'

field.name: dm_vlgc_comp_sts
field.description: 1: DM > VLGC Detected 0: DM < VLGC Detected Note: This status shall be re-used from the single ended receiver output of D- whenever dm_vlgc_comp_en is '1'

field.name: dcd_comp_sts
field.description: Data Contact Detect (DCD) Comparator Status 1: DP line is asserted 0: DP line is not asserted

field.name: otgsessvalid
field.description: B-Peripheral is Valid: Indicates if the session for a B-Peripheral is valid (0.8V < VTH < 4.0V). The signal bvalid from OTG 1.3 is now renamed as otgsessvalid. 0: VBUS < 0.8V 1: VBUS > 4.0V

field.name: adp_probe_ana
field.description: Output of ADP Probe Comparator. 0: VBUS < 0.6V 1: VBUS > 0.75V

field.name: adp_sense_ana
field.description: Output of ADP Sense Comparator. 0: VBUS < 0.2V 1: VBUS > 0.55V

field.name: sessend
field.description: VBUS Valid: Indicates if the voltage on VBUS is at a valid level for operation (4.4V < VTH < 4.75V). 0: VBUS < 4.4V 1: VBUS > 4.75V

field.name: rid_float_comp_sts
field.description: RID float comparator status 1: RID_FLOAT Detected on ID Pin 0: RID_FLOAT not Detected on ID Pin

field.name: rid_gnd_comp_sts
field.description: RID GND comparator status 1: RID_GND Detected on ID Pin 0: RID_GND not Detected on ID Pin

field.name: rid_c_comp_sts
field.description: RID C comparator status 1: RID_C Detected on ID Pin 0: RID_C not Detected on ID Pin

field.name: rid_b_comp_sts
field.description: RID B comparator status 1: RID_B Detected on ID Pin 0: RID_B not Detected on ID Pin

field.name: rid_a_comp_sts
field.description: RID A comparator status 1: RID_A Detected on ID Pin 0: RID_A not Detected on ID Pin

field.name: iddig
field.description: ID Pin Status: Indicates whether the connected USB plug is Micro-A or Micro-B. This is only valid when idpullup is set to '1'. It must be valid within 50ms after idpullup is set to '1'. 0: Connected plug is a Micro-A 1: Connected plug is a Micro-B

field.name: linestate
field.description: Line State: These signals reflect the current state of the single ended receivers. They are combinatorial until a 'usable' sieclock is available, then they are synchronized to sieclock. They reflect the current state of the DP (linestate [0]) and DM (linestate [1]) signals. 00: SE0 (Single Ended Zero) 01: 'J' State 10: 'K' State 11: SE1 (Single Ended One)

field.name: ADP_RAMP_TIME
field.description: ADP ramp time measurement value. Software should read this register upon ADP_PROBE_COMPLETED_INT_EN interrupt detection

field.name: adp_en
field.description: ADP Feature Enable. This signal is the master enable for all the ADP PHY logics. 0: ADP Logics are powered OFF 1: ADP Logics are powered ON

field.name: adp_probe_en
field.description: This signal enables the probe mode of the ADP. During this mode, probe comparators and the current sources will be ON based on the source and sink current enables. 0: ADP Probe Mode OFF 1: ADP Probe Mode ON

field.name: adp_sense_en
field.description: This signal enables the probe mode of the ADP. During this mode, sense comparators and the current sources will be ON based on the source and sink current enables. 0: ADP Probe Sense OFF 1: ADP Probe Sense ON

field.name: adp_sink_current_en
field.description: When this signal is high, VBUS is discharged to ground. This signal should be asserted 5us after the assertion of adp_en. 0: ADP Sink Current Enable OFF 1: ADP Sink Current Enable ON

field.name: adp_source_current_en
field.description: When this signal is high, VBUS is charged to the probe threshold (0.75V). This signal should be asserted 5us after the assertion of adp_en. 0: ADP Source Current Enable OFF 1: ADP Source Current Enable ON

field.name: do_adp_prb
field.description: ADP probing enable in automated mode

field.name: do_adp_sns
field.description: ADP sensing enable in automated mode

field.name: adp_auto
field.description: ADP mode. If set to 1 ADP probing is controlled by internal FSM. If set to 0 then software should control ADP sequence

field.name: bc_en
field.description: Battery Charging Circuits Master Enable. 1: BC Enabled 0: BC Disabled

field.name: idm_sink_en
field.description: 1: Current Sink on DM Enabled 0: Current Sink on DM Disabled

field.name: idp_sink_en
field.description: 1: Current Sink on DP Enabled 0: Current Sink on DP Disabled

field.name: idp_src_en
field.description: 1: Current Source on DP Enabled 0: Current Source on DP Disabled

field.name: vdm_src_en
field.description: 1: Voltage Source on DM Enabled 0: Voltage Source on DM Disabled

field.name: vdp_src_en
field.description: 1: Voltage Source on DP Enabled 0: Voltage Source on DP Disabled

field.name: dm_vdat_ref_comp_en
field.description: 1: DM to VDAT_REF Comparator Enabled 0: DM to VDAT_REF Comparator Disabled

field.name: dm_vlgc_comp_en
field.description: 1: DM to VLGC Comparator Enabled 0: DM to VLGC Comparator Disabled

field.name: dp_vdat_ref_comp_en
field.description: 1: DP to VDAT_REF Comparator Enabled 0: DP to VDAT_REF Comparator Disabled

field.name: rid_float_comp_en
field.description: 1: RID Float Comparator Enabled 0: RID Float Comparator Disabled Note: This ID Comparator enable is used to detect whether the ID line is floating or non-floating. If it is identified to be non-floating, then rid_nonfloat_comp_en is enabled to check for RID_A or RID_B or RID_C or RID_GND

field.name: rid_nonfloat_comp_en
field.description: 1: RID Non-Float Comparator Enabled 0: RID Non-Float Comparator Disabled Note: This ID Comparator enable is used to detect the presence of RID_A or RID_B or RID_C or RID_GND when the ID pin is non-floating

field.name: bc_pulldownctrl
field.description: BC pulldowncotrol 1: puldowns are controlled by bc_dppulldown and bc_dmpulldown 0: puldowns are controlled by OTG

field.name: idpullup
field.description: ID Pin Sample Enable: Active High. Signal that enables the sampling of the analog ID line. 0: Sampling of ID pin is disabled, iddig is not valid 1: Sampling of ID pin is enabled

field.name: drive_vbus_sel
field.description: VBUS drive control select. This register allows SW driver take control over drive_vbus as follows: 0: drive_vbus controlled from OTG controller 1: drive_vbus controlled from SFR

field.name: drive_vbus_sfr
field.description: SFR drive_vbus control. 0: drive_vbus = 0 1: drive_vbus = 1 This bit is valid only with OTGCTRL1.drive_vbus_sel set to '1'. This bit is auto-cleared upon over-current condition

field.name: force_opmode01
field.description: with both cores disabled seting this bit to '1' will result with forcing UTMI opmode set to 2'b01 (non-driving)

field.name: TA_ADP_PRB
field.description: A-device ADP probing period. TA_ADP_PRB = {reg_value} * 10 ms

field.name: TB_ADP_PRB
field.description: B-device ADP probing period. TB_ADP_PRB = {reg_value} * 10 ms

field.name: ADP_CHRG_TMOUT
field.description: ADP probing timeout value. Defines maximum time for ADP charging. If this time is reached during charging then adp_chrg_tmout_det bit in OTGADPBCSTS is set ADP_CHRG_TMOUT = {reg_value} * 1 ms

field.name: T_ADP_DSCHG
field.description: ADP probing discharge time. T_ADP_DSCHG = {reg_value} * 1 ms

field.name: CAPLENGTH
field.description: Capability Registers Length (CAPLENGTH). This register is used as an offset to add to register base to find the beginning of the Operational Register Space

field.name: HCIVERSION
field.description: Host Controller Interface Version Number (HCIVERSION). This is a two-byte register containing a BCD encoding of the xHCI specification revision number supported by this host controller. The most significant byte of this register represents a major revision and the least significant byte is the minor revision. e.g. 0100h corresponds to xHCI version 1.0

field.name: MaxSlots
field.description: Number of Device Slots (MaxSlots). This field specifies the maximum number of Device Context Structures and Doorbell Array entries this host controller can support. Valid values are in the range of 1 to 255. The value of 0 is reserved

field.name: MaxIntrs
field.description: Number of Interrupters (MaxIntrs). This field specifies the number of Interrupters implemented on this host controller. Each Interrupter may be allocated to a MSI or MSI-X vector and controls its generation and moderation. The value of this field determines how many Interrupter Register Sets are addressable in the Runtime Register Space (refer to section 5.5 of xHCI specification).
