Writing '1' to this bit informs USBSS-DEV that in-system memory has prepared a new Transfer Descriptor for selected endpoints. If an IN endpoint is 'Not Ready' (NRDY=1 in Endpoint Status Register), then setting the DRDY bit (which is proceeded by DMA transfer to the on-chip buffers) will cause the device to send the ERDY packet. If the TRB error occurs, the DRDY bit is cleared and held in the low state until the TRBERR is not cleared (even if the DTRANS bit is set, the Multiple TRB chain mode is enabled). This bit is duplicated in the Doorbell register. Writing '1' to this bit while DESCMIS interrupt flag is set for the same endpoint will also clear the DESCMIS flag

field.name: DFLUSH
field.description: Data flush. Writing '1' to this bit performs the following actions for particular endpoint: - clears DRDY bit and stops DMA transfer - flush endpoint data from on chip buffers As in case of Endpoint reset (EPRST bit), after endpoint data flush the software is responsible for it to re-set the Endpoint TRADDR. When DFLUSH operation is started ('1' is written), CPU must wait until this bit becomes again '0' (it indicates that HW finishes all internal opertations related to DFLUSH), and only then can proceed with next software operations. Writing '0' has no effect

field.name: STDL
field.description: Transfer Descriptor Length write (used only for Bulk Stream capable endpoints in SS mode). Writing '1' to this bit writes to the device the TDL field. The bit is automatically cleared.

field.name: TDL
field.description: Transfer Descriptor Length (used only in SS mode for bulk endpoints). Using the field TDL for bulk EP assumes TDL_CHK bit enabled. This field will be writen to the device when the EP_CMD.STDL bit is set to '1'. This field is used by the device when particular endpoint: - is configured as Stream capable (EP_CFG.STREAM_EN bit is set) or - the IOT interrupt is to be used This field should be written each time, when bit EP_CMD.DRDY is written (i.e. device is notified that new TD is ready). The written value should correspond to the prepared data size (multiple of endpoint MAXPKTSIZE eg. in KB for BULK EP) in the transfer descriptor (which has been prepared for this endpoint before DRDY bit is set) rounded up (if short packet expected). This field has to be written no later than DRDY (or Dorbel) bit. 1) For OUT endpoints device will decrement this field by one after each successful packet received from the host. 2) For IN endpoints device will decrement this field by one after each successful handshake packet received from the host. As long as this field is not decremented to zero, then for each response NRDY that device send to the host (e.g. due to temporary lack of space (OUT EP) / packets (IN EP) in the on-chip buffers), device will automatically send the ERDY package to the host as soon as free spece (OUT EP) / new packet (IN EP) will be available in the on-chip buffers. When the field TDL is decremented to zero then, it will mean that the device does not expect to have more packets from the host (OUT EP) / does not want to send more packets (IN EP). Then device generates IOT interrupt and from this moment ERDY TP will not be sent automatically if endpoint enters flow control. Additionally, if TDL_CHK is set (only for BULK EP), and TDL value is equal to zero, device will: - for OUT EP - not accept any data packet from host for particular EP, even if there are empty OUT buffers. In this case device answer with NRDY TP and NRDY interrupt will be requested. - for IN EP - send last programmed (according to the TDL field) with EOB bit set. Writing into this field any value at the time when the previous value of this field was not zero, will result in adding these two values

field.name: ERDY_SID
field.description: ERDY Stream ID value (used in SS mode). This field contains SID - it will be sent to host in ERDY packet (by writing '1' to ERDY). This field is meaningfull only in SuperSpeed mode

field.name: SETUP
field.description: Setup transfer complete. Bit used only for EP0. If setup type transmission has been completed and data from host has been received and copied to system memory, this bit is set to '1' and interrupt is generated. Setup packet is applicable only to control transmissions (EP0). This interrupt can be masked by the corresponding bit in EP_STS_EN register. Writing '1' to this bit clears the interrupt

field.name: STALL
field.description: Endpoint STALL status 0 - endpoint is not stalled 1 - endpoint is stalled This bit is not treated as an interrupt (not reported in the EP__ISTS register). This bit is read-only

field.name: IOC
field.description: Interrupt On Complete When DMA transfer is completed and transfer descriptor is updated, then this bit is set to 1 and interrupt is generated. Enabling or disabling of this interrupt is realized by IOC bit in transfer descriptor. Additionally, this interrupt can be masked for a particular endpoint in EP__ISTS register. When in given transfer descriptor both interrupts (IOC and ISP interrupts) are enabled, then in the case of short packet, only one interrupt is generated - SP. Writing '1' to this bit clears the interrupt

field.name: ISP
field.description: Interrupt on Short Packet. This bit is set to 1 and interrupt is generated when a transfer containing less data than MaxPacket for a given endpoint has been completed and transfer descriptor has been updated.Enabling or disabling of interrupt is realized by ISP bit in transfer descriptor. Additionally, this interrupt can be masked for a particular endpoint in EP__ISTS register. When in given transfer descriptor both interrupts are enabled (IOC and ISP), then in the case of short packet only one interrupt is generated - SP. Writing '1' to this bit clears the interrupt

field.name: DESCMIS
field.description: Transfer descriptor missing. This bit is set to 1 and interrupt is generated when any of the following conditions are met: - device is requested to send data to host and none of Transfer Descriptor is prepared (IN transfer) - device receives OUT packet and cannot transmit it using DMA as Transfer Descriptor has not been prepared (DRDY was not set) for it (OUT transfer) Note1: This interrupt is not generated for ISO IN endpoints. For such endpoints the ISOERR interrupt should be used. Note2: DMA will not start operating on transfer descriptor array until the OUT packet is received (or host requests IN packet) and processor has not previously notified DMA (by writing to EP_CMD register of DRDY register). Note2: For BULK OUT endpoints with TDL_CHK bit set this interrupt will not by requested as device will not accept any packet from host when TRB is not prepared (and TDL is not written with non-zero value). In this case the NRDY interrupt should be used instead of DESMIS. Writing '1' to this bit or writing '1' to EP_CMD.DRDY bit of endpoints which generated interrupt will delete the interrupt. This interrupt can be masked by the corresponding bit in EP_STS_EN register. Writing '1' to this bit clears the interrupt

field.name: STREAMR
field.description: Stream Rejected (used only in SS mode). This bit is set to '1' if device tries to initiate stream number and host does not accept it. Stream support is class-dependent. This interrupt can be masked by the corresponding bit in STREAMREN register. Writing '1' to this bit clears the interrupt

field.name: MD_EXIT
field.description: EXIT from MOVE DATA State (used only for stream transfers in SS mode) This bit is set to '1' if stream capable endpoint exits from MOVE DATA state of Bulk IN/OUT Stream Ptrotocol State Machine (ISPSM/OSPSM). Stream support is class-dependent. This interrupt can be masked by the corresponding bit in MD_EXITEN register. Writing '1' to this bit clears the interrupt

field.name: TRBERR
field.description: TRB error. This bit is set if DMA read corrupted TRB (wrong C bit value or TRB type). Address of the TRB is stored in the EP_TRADDR register. This interrupt can be masked by the corresponding bit in EP_STS_EN register. If this error occurs, the bit DRDY is cleared and held in the low state until the TRBERR is not cleared. To start the DMA again, the software has to clear this interrupt and set the DRDY bit once more. Writing '1' to this bit clears the interrupt

field.name: NRDY
field.description: Not ready (used only in SS mode). This bit is automatically set to 1 when for some reason endpoint enters Flow Control. If ERDY is sent automatically by the endpoint (what is done when current TDL value is greater then zero), this interrupt bit is not automatically cleared (although the endpoint itself leaves FlowControl). Note: For BULK OUT endpoints with TDL_CHK bit seting this interrupt should be used instead of DESCMIS interrupt. See also DESCMIS description. Writing '1' to this bit clears the interrupt

field.name: DBUSY
field.description: DMA busy. This bit is set to '1' while the DMA services the endpoint. Through the service means either actual transmission of data between on-chip cache and system memory for particular endpoint or a pending data transmission which has already begun but was interrupted by endpoint with a higher priority. Such pending transmissions will begin automatically themselves after these higher priority. This bit is only a status bit (not an interrupt flag)

field.name: BUFFEMPTY
field.description: Endpoint Buffer Empty. When this bit is set to '1', there are no packets for the particular endpoint in the on-chip buffers. This bit is only a status bit (not an interrupt flag)

field.name: CCS
field.description: Current Cycle Status. Informs about current value of C bit corresponding to DMA ownership of TRBs for selected endpoint. For more information about TRBs C bit see chapter 2.11.3. This bit is only a status bit (not an interrupt flag)

field.name: PRIME
field.description: Prime (used only in SS mode). This bit is set when the device receives the packet with PRIME ID. This interrupt can be masked by the corresponding bit in EP_STS_EN register. Writing '1' to this bit clears the interrupt

field.name: SIDERR
field.description: Stream error (used only in SS mode) If host requested IN (sent OUT) packet with particular Stream ID, and device is actually programmed to transfer packets with different Stream ID (SID written in the EP_CMD.ERDY_SID field) the host IN request (OUT packet) is rejected (NRDY) and the SIDERR interrupt is requested. In case of IN direction, the SIDERR interrupt will not be requested when device is not prepared for any transfer (EP_CMD.TDL= 0 for this endpoint). In this case (and additionally when EP_CMD.DRDY= 0 and EP_STS.DBUSY=0), the DESCMIS interrupt will be requested. This interrupt can be masked by the corresponding bit in EP_STS_EN register. Writing '1' to this bit clears the interrupt

field.name: OUTSMM
field.description: OUT size mismatch. This bit is set when host sends a different data size than device was anticipating (according to Data Length field in TRB). In such a case, the DMA updates length field in current TRB, updates TRADDR (next TRB address), and triggers the interrupt. DMA will not start processing TRB ring of this EP until its DRDY is set. This interrupt can be masked by the corresponding bit in EP_STS_EN register. Writing '1' to this bit clears the interrupt

field.name: ISOERR
field.description: ISO transmission error. Error of isochronous transmission. This bit is set during data transmission to/from ISO endpoints while the last data transfer at PIPE IF is in current micro frame. For ISO IN endpoints: If host asks for data packet and device is not ready for sent data immediatelly, then ISOERR flag is set for particular endpoint and core sends a 0-length DATA packet to the host. The next data portion transfer (for the next micro frame) from system memory to on-chip buffers is automatically started (when EP_CMD.DRDY bit is set or DMA works in DMULT mode). For ISO OUT endpoints: When host issues an OUT data packet for the specific endpoint but the OUT buffers are full, then device is unable to receive data packet and the ISOERR flag is set. For more information about ISO trasfer see chapter 'Isochronous Transfers'. This interrupt can be masked by the corresponding bit in EP_STS_EN register. Writing '1' to this bit clears the interrupt

field.name: HOSTPP
field.description: Host Packet Pending (only for SS mode). Depending on whether the endpoint is enabled for streams or not, this bit behaves as follows: 1)For stream enabled bulk endpoints (EP_CFG.EPSTREAM_EN bit set): This bit reflects the PP bit in the last packet received from the host during Move Data state of the DOSPSM for the OUT endpoint. This bit is updated on exit from the MOVE DATA state of the DOSPSM and can be analyzed during servicing MD_EXIT interrupt for BULK OUT endpoint with Stream support enabled. If this bit is set to '0' during MD_EXIT interrupt, it means that the host terminated current stream. If this bit is set to '1' during MD_EXIT interrupt, it means that the host doesn't terminated current stream and still has data for this stream. 2)Non stream bulk endpoints (EP_CFG.EPSTREAM_EN bit not set): This bit reflects the PP bit in the packets received from the host. This bit is updated as long as the EP_CMD.TDL is nonzero and it can be analyzed during servicing IOT interrupt for BULK endpoints. This bit is only a status bit (not an interrupt flag)

field.name: SPSMST
field.description: Stream Protocol State Machine State (only for Bulk stream endpoints) This field is valid only for stream capable bulk endpoints and reflects the current state of the Stream Protocol State Machine for selected endpoint: 0 - DISABLED 1 - IDLE 2 - START_STREAM 3 - MOVE_DATA Soft should check if the SPSM is in IDLE state before sending ERDY TP from stream EP (leading to the transition from IDE to START_STREAM) Before software will order to send an ERDY TP from stream capable endpoint (leading to the transition from IDLE to START_STREAM) it should first check if the SPSM is in IDLE state. This bit is only a status bit (not an interrupt flag)

field.name: IOT
field.description: Interrupt On Transfer complete. This interrupt is generated when the field EP_CMD.TDL is decremented to zero. It means that the device - does not expect to have more packets from the host (OUT EP) - does not want to send more packets (IN EP) More information can be found in the description of EP_CMD.TDL field. Writing '1' to this bit clears the interrupt

field.name: RESERVED0
field.description: Reserved field. Write ignored. 0 when read

field.name: OUTQ_NO
field.description: OUT queue endpoint number. This field shows the number of the endpoint to which the packet, received by the host, currently is waiting to be transmitted by the DMA from the on-chip buffers to the system memory. As there is one buffers queue for all Out Endpoints, this field is not endpoint related, and thus it can be read regardless of current value stored in the EP_SEL register. This bit is only a status bit (not an interrupt flag)

field.name: OUTQ_VAL
field.description: OUT queue valid flag. This field indicates whether the endpoint number of the OUT packet waiting for transmission by the DMA, is valid or not. In other words, whether the packet queue is not empty. As there is one buffers queue for all Out Endpoints, this field is not endpoint related, and thus it can be read regardless of current value stored in the EP_SEL register. 0 - queue of out packets is empty thus OUTQ_NO is not valid 1 - queue of out packets is not empty thus OUTQ_NO is valid This bit is only a status bit (not an interrupt flag)

field.name: RESERVED1
field.description: Reserved field. Write ignored. 0 when read

field.name: STPWAIT
field.description: Bit used only for EP0. If setup packet is received correctly and stored in the on-chip buffer, this bit is set to 1 and interrupt is generated. Setup packet is applicable only to control transmissions (EP0). This interrupt can be masked by the corresponding bit in EP_STS_EN register. Writing '1' to this bit clears the interrupt

field.name: SID
field.description: Stream ID (used only in SS mode). Stream ID of packet, which generates interrupt. The interrupts that update the SID field are: - SIDERR for EP OUT - SIDERR/DESCMIS for EP IN For the above interrupts, the values of the SID field reflects: - in case of SIDERR for EP OUT this field reflects the Stream ID of OUT packet sent by host which was rejected by the device, due to SID_CHK bit set - in case of SIDERR/DESCMIS for EP IN this field reflects the Stream ID of ACK TP sent by host which was rejected by the device

field.name: RESERVED
field.description: Reserved field. Write ignored. 0 when read

field.name: SETUPEN
field.description: Setup transfer complete. This bit enables the SETUP interrupt. Valid only for EP0

field.name: RESERVED0
field.description: Reserved field. Write ignored. 0 when read

field.name: DESCMISEN
field.description: OUT transfer missing descriptor enable. This bit enables the DESCMIS interrupt

field.name: STREAMREN
field.description: Stream Rejected enable. This bit enables the STREAMR interrupt

field.name: MD_EXITEN
field.description: Move Data Exit enable. This bit enables the MD_EXIT interrupt

field.name: TRBERREN
field.description: TRB enable. This bit enables the TRBERR interrupt

field.name: NRDYEN
field.description: NRDY enable. This bit enables the NRDY interrupt

field.name: RESERVED1
field.description: Reserved field. Write ignored. 0 when read

field.name: PRIMEEN
field.description: Prime enable. This bit enables the PRIME interrupt

field.name: SIDERREN
field.description: Stream error enable. This bit enables the SIDERR interrupt

field.name: OUTSMMEN
field.description: OUT size mismatch enable. This bit enables the OUTSMM interrupt

field.name: ISOERREN
field.description: ISO transmission error enable. This bit enables the ISOERR interrupt

field.name: RESERVED2
field.description: Reserved field. Write ignored. 0 when read

field.name: IOTEN
field.description: Interrupt on Transmission complete enable. This bit enables the IOT interrupt

field.name: RESERVED3
field.description: Reserved field. Write ignored. 0 when read

field.name: STPWAITEN
field.description: Setup Wait interrupt enable. This bit enables the STPWAIT interrupt. Valid only for EP0

field.name: PSO_EN
field.description: Power Shut Off capability enable. Writing '1' to this bit enables dower domains switching capability and clears the PSO_DS bit. The Domain will be switched off if both PSO_EN will be set and the USB controller will be in the in the U3 state. It is recommended to set this bit in U3ENTI interrupt service, after software ensures that no data transfer is pending. If this bit will be always set, the controller will automatically switch off the power in the switchable PD after USB controller will enter U3 state

field.name: PSO_DS
field.description: Power Shut Off capability disable. Writing '1' to this bit disables power domains switching capability and clears the PSO_EN bit. It is recommended to set this bit after during U3EXTI interrupt service

field.name: RESERVED0
field.description: Reserved field. Write ignored. 0 when read

field.name: STB_CLK_SWITCH_EN
field.description: Enables turning-off Reference Clock. This bit is optional and implemented only when support for OTG is implemented (indicated by OTG_READY bit set to 1)

field.name: STB_CLK_SWITCH_DONE
field.description: Status bit indicating that operation required by STB_CLK_SWITCH_EN write is completed. This bit is optional and implemented only when support for OTG is implemented (indicated by OTG_READY bit set to 1)

field.name: RESERVED1
field.description: Reserved field. Write ignored. 0 when read

field.name: FAST_REG_ACCESS_STAT
field.description: Fast Registers Access status. This bit informs if Fast Registers Access is enabled. It should be used as described in FAST_REG_ACCESS bit

field.name: FAST_REG_ACCESS
field.description: Fast Registers Access. When Device Port is in a low power state (U3/L2/Not Connected), accesses to registers listed in section 2.3 of USBSS-DEV design specification may take long time. In order to enable fast register access in that case, user can use this register in the following way: - set FAST_REG_ACCESS bit - wait until FAST_REG_ACCESS_STAT bit is set - perform required accesses - clear FAST_REG_ACCESS bit Note that to enable USBSS-DEV low power state entry (U3/L2), the FAST_REG_ACCESS bit has to be cleared

field.name: AHB_RETRY_EN
field.description: AHB retry enable. This bit enables the AHB retrys for AHB slave interface. This bit has no effect when AHB slave interface is not implemented

field.name: RESERVED
field.description: Reserved field. Write ignored. 0 when read

field.name: SFR_TYPE
field.description: SFR Interface type. This field reflects type of SFR interface implemented: 0x0 - OCP, 0x1 - AHB, 0x2 - PLB, 0x3 - AXI, 0x4-0xF - reserved

field.name: SFR_WIDTH
field.description: SFR Interface width. This field reflects width of SFR interface implemented: - 0x0: 8 bit interface, - 0x1: 16 bit interface, - 0x2: 32 bit interface, - 0x3: 64 bit interface, - 0x4-0xF: reserved

field.name: DMA_TYPE
field.description: DMA Interface type. This field reflects type of DMA interface implemented: - 0x0: OCP, - 0x1: AHB, - 0x2: PLB, - 0x3: AXI, - 0x4-0xF: reserved

field.name: DMA_WIDTH
field.description: DMA Interface width. This field reflects width of DMA interface implemented: - 0x0: reserved, - 0x1: reserved, - 0x2: 32 bit interface, - 0x3: 64 bit interface, - 0x4-0xF: reserved

field.name: U3PHY_TYPE
field.description: USB3 PHY Interface type. This field reflects type of USB3 PHY interface implemented: - 0x0: USB PIPE, - 0x1: RMMI, - 0x2-0xF: reserved

field.name: U3PHY_WIDTH
field.description: USB3 PHY Interface width. This field reflects width of USB3 PHY interface implemented: - 0x0: 8 bit PIPE interface, - 0x1: 16 bit PIPE interface, - 0x2: 32 bit PIPE interface, - 0x3: 64 bit PIPE interface, - 0x4-0xF: reserved. Note: When SSIC interface is implemented this field shows the width of internal PIPE interface. The RMMI interface is always 20-bit wide

field.name: U2PHY_EN
field.description: USB2 PHY Interface enable. This field informs if USB2 PHY interface is implemented: - interface NOT implemented: 0x0, - interface implemented: 0x1

field.name: U2PHY_TYPE
field.description: USB2 PHY Interface type. This field reflects type of USB2 PHY interface implemented: - UTMI: 0x0, - ULPI: 0x1

field.name: U2PHY_WIDTH
field.description: USB2 PHY Interface width. This field reflects width of USB2 PHY interface implemented: - 8 bit interface: 0x0, - 16 bit interface: 0x1. Note: The ULPI interface is always 8-bit wide

field.name: OTG_READY
field.description: This field informs if device is OTG ready: - pure device mode: 0x0, - some features and ports for CDNS USB OTG controller are implemented: 0x1

field.name: RESERVED
field.description: This field is reserved and it is always 0 when reading

field.name: ACTUAL_MEM_SIZE
field.description: The actual size of the connected On-chip RAM memory in kB: - 0 means 256 kB (max supported mem size) - value other than 0 reflects the mem size in kB. This value reflects the CDNS_USBSSDEV_ATTACHED_MEM_SIZE parameter defined in the usbss_dev_defines.v file. This value has to be adequately set before synthesis by engineer who connects the on-chip memory for controller

field.name: MAX_MEM_SIZE
field.description: Max supported mem size. This field reflects width of on-chip RAM address bus width, which determines max supported mem size: 0x0-0x7 reserved, 0x8 - support for 4kB mem, 0x9 - support for 8kB mem, 0xA - support for 16kB mem, 0xB - support for 32kB mem, 0xC - support for 64kB mem, 0xD - support for 128kB mem, 0xE - support for 256kB mem, 0xF - reserved

field.name: DEBOUNCER_CNT
field.description: This parameter defines the VBUS debouncer delay i.e. the time interval between the VBUS detection on device input and the start of using it internally. Resolution of this parameter is 128 ns. For simulation purposes it is recommended to set the value 1 (128ns) For synthesis purposes it is recommended to set the value 230000 (~30ms)

field.name: RESERVED
field.description: Reserved field. Write ignored. 0 when read

field.name: LFPS_MIN_DET_U1_EXIT
field.description: LFPS_MIN_DET_U1_EXIT value This parameter configures the minimum time required for decoding the received LFPS as an LFPS.U1_Exit. Example is shown in the chapter 4. This field is saved to the device only when the field LFPS_MIN_DET_U1_EXIT_SET is set to '1' during write to the DBG_LINK1 register. Resolution of this parameter is 8 ns. For simulation purposes it is recommended to set the value 36 (~300ns). For synthesis purposes it is recommended to set the value 36 (~300ns)

field.name: LFPS_MIN_GEN_U1_EXIT
field.description: LFPS_MIN_GEN_U1_EXIT value This parameter configures the minimum time for phytxelecidle deassertion when LFPS.U1_Exit signalling is generated as shown in the chapter 4. This field is saved to the device only when the field LFPS_MIN_GEN_U1_EXIT_SET is set to '1' during write to the DBG_LINK1 register. Resolution of this parameter is 8 ns. For simulation purposes it is recommended to set the value 87 (~696ns) For synthesis purposes it is recommended to set the value 87 (~696ns)

field.name: RXDET_BREAK_DIS
field.description: RXDET_BREAK_DIS value This parameter configures terminating the Far-end Receiver termination detection sequence: '0': it is possible that USBSS_DEV will terminate Far-end receiver termination detection sequence '1': USBSS_DEV will not terminate Far-end receiver termination detection sequence The impact of the bit to the link behaviour is shown in chapter 4. This field is saved to the device only when the field RXDET_BREAK_DIS_SET is set to '1' during write to the DBG_LINK1

field.name: LFPS_GEN_PING
field.description: LFPS_GEN_PING value This parameter configures the LFPS.Ping generation time as shown in the chapter 4. This field is saved to the device only when the field LFPS_GEN_PING_SET is set to '1' during write to the DBG_LINK1 register. Resolution of this parameter is 8 ns. For simulation purposes it is recommended to set the value 24 (~200ns) For synthesis purposes it is recommended to set the value 24 (~200ns)

field.name: PHYRXVAL_DVAL

field.name: AXI_DECERR_EN
field.description: This bit enables interrupt on AXI DECODE ERROR detection. When 1 and AXI_DECERR is 1 then AXI DECODE ERROR interrupt is requested. When 0 - disabled interrupt from this source

field.name: AXI_SLVERR_EN
field.description: This bit enables interrupt on AXI SLAVE ERROR detection. When 1 and AXI_SLVERR is 1 then AXI SLAVE ERROR interrupt is requested. When 0 - disabled interrupt from this source

field.name: AXI_DECERR
field.description: This bit provides an information about AXI DECODE ERROR response on B or R channel. This flag is cleared by writing '1' to it. Once set it is held until cleared

field.name: AXI_SLVERR
field.description: This bit provides an information about AXI SLAVE ERROR response on B or R channel. This flag is cleared by writing '1' to it. Once set it is held until cleared

field.name: AXI_IDLE
field.description: This bit provides information about the AXI Master state: '1': no pending action required by the AXI Master wrapper, '0': the AXI Master wrapper has outstanding transactions

field.name: B_MAX
field.description: The register controls maximum burst length - it is used by the AXI Master wrapper to determine maximum value of AxLEN. It uses AXI AxLEN encoding. Default value is the maximum supported one and it is implementation specific. Width of this register is the same as AxLEN signals width. Note: This register should only be written to during the register initialisation process

field.name: ROT
field.description: Number of outstanding read transactions that can be initiated by the AXI Master wrapper. Default value of this field is CDNS_USBSSDEV_AXI_WCD-1 (define parameter). The value written to this field should be the requested number of outstanding read transactions minus 1, thus the actual number of possible outstanding read transactions is one more than the programmed value. Note: This register should only be written to during the register initialization process

field.name: WOT
field.description: Number of outstanding write transactions that can be initiated by the AXI Master wrapper. Default value of this field is CDNS_USBSSDEV_AXI_WCD-1 (define parameter). The value written to this field should be the requested number of outstanding write transactions minus 1, thus the actual number of possible outstanding write transactions is one more than the programmed value. Note: This register should only be written to during the register initialization process

enumeratedValue.name: NO_DMA_XFER
enumeratedValue.description: Perform any requested PIO word transfers but terminate command before any DMA transfer.

enumeratedValue.name: DMA_WRITE
enumeratedValue.description: Perform any requested PIO word transfers and then perform a DMA transfer from the peripheral for the specified number of bytes.

enumeratedValue.name: DMA_READ
enumeratedValue.description: Perform any requested PIO word transfers and then perform a DMA transfer to the peripheral for the specified number of bytes.

enumeratedValue.name: DMA_SENSE
enumeratedValue.description: Perform any requested PIO word transfers and then perform a conditional branch to the next chained device. Follow the NEXCMD_ADDR pointer if the perpheral sense is true. Follow the BUFFER_ADDRESS as a chain pointer if the peripheral sense line is false.

enumeratedValue.name: IDLE
enumeratedValue.description: This is the idle state of the DMA state machine.

enumeratedValue.name: REQ_CMD1
enumeratedValue.description: State in which the DMA is waiting to receive the first word of a command.

enumeratedValue.name: REQ_CMD3
enumeratedValue.description: State in which the DMA is waiting to receive the third word of a command.

enumeratedValue.name: REQ_CMD2
enumeratedValue.description: State in which the DMA is waiting to receive the second word of a command.

enumeratedValue.name: XFER_DECODE
enumeratedValue.description: The state machine processes the descriptor command field in this state and branches accordingly.

enumeratedValue.name: REQ_WAIT
enumeratedValue.description: The state machine waits in this state for the PIO APB cycles to complete.

enumeratedValue.name: REQ_CMD4
enumeratedValue.description: State in which the DMA is waiting to receive the fourth word of a command, or waiting to receive the PIO words when PIO count is greater than 1.

enumeratedValue.name: PIO_REQ
enumeratedValue.description: This state determines whether another PIO cycle needs to occur before starting DMA transfers.

enumeratedValue.name: READ_FLUSH
enumeratedValue.description: During a read transfers, the state machine enters this state waiting for the last bytes to be pushed out on the APB.

enumeratedValue.name: READ_WAIT
enumeratedValue.description: When an AHB read request occurs, the state machine waits in this state for the AHB transfer to complete.

enumeratedValue.name: WRITE
enumeratedValue.description: During DMA Write transfers, the state machine waits in this state until the AHB master arbiter accepts the request from this channel.

enumeratedValue.name: READ_REQ
enumeratedValue.description: During DMA Read transfers, the state machine waits in this state until the AHB master arbiter accepts the request from this channel.

enumeratedValue.name: CHECK_CHAIN
enumeratedValue.description: Upon completion of the DMA transfers, this state checks the value of the Chain bit and branches accordingly.

enumeratedValue.name: XFER_COMPLETE
enumeratedValue.description: The state machine goes to this state after the DMA transfers are complete, and determines what step to take next.

enumeratedValue.name: TERMINATE
enumeratedValue.description: When a terminate signal is set, the state machine enters this state until the current AHB transfer is completed.

enumeratedValue.name: WAIT_END
enumeratedValue.description: When the Wait for Command End bit is set, the state machine enters this state until the DMA device indicates that the command is complete.

enumeratedValue.name: WRITE_WAIT
enumeratedValue.description: During DMA Write transfers, the state machine waits in this state until the AHB master completes the write to the AHB memory space.

enumeratedValue.name: HALT_AFTER_TERM
enumeratedValue.description: If HALTONTERMINATE is set and a terminate signal is set, the state machine enters this state and effectively halts. A channel reset is required to exit this state

enumeratedValue.name: CHECK_WAIT
enumeratedValue.description: If the Chain bit is a 0, the state machine enters this state and effectively halts.

enumeratedValue.name: WAIT_READY
enumeratedValue.description: When the NAND Wait for Ready bit is set, the state machine enters this state until the GPMI device indicates that the external device is ready.

enumeratedValue.name: XFER_DECODE
enumeratedValue.description: The state machine processes the descriptor command field in this state and branches accordingly.

enumeratedValue.name: REQ_WAIT

enumeratedValue.name: REQ_CMD4
enumeratedValue.description: State in which the DMA is waiting to receive the fourth word of a command, or waiting to receive the PIO words when PIO count is greater than 1.

enumeratedValue.name: PIO_REQ
enumeratedValue.description: This state determines whether another PIO cycle needs to occur before starting DMA transfers.

enumeratedValue.name: READ_FLUSH
enumeratedValue.description: During a read transfers, the state machine enters this state waiting for the last bytes to be pushed out on the APB.

enumeratedValue.name: READ_WAIT
enumeratedValue.description: When an AHB read request occurs, the state machine waits in this state for the AHB transfer to complete.

enumeratedValue.name: WRITE
enumeratedValue.description: During DMA Write transfers, the state machine waits in this state until the AHB master arbiter accepts the request from this channel.

enumeratedValue.name: READ_REQ
enumeratedValue.description: During DMA Read transfers, the state machine waits in this state until the AHB master arbiter accepts the request from this channel.

enumeratedValue.name: CHECK_CHAIN
enumeratedValue.description: Upon completion of the DMA transfers, this state checks the value of the Chain bit and branches accordingly.

enumeratedValue.name: XFER_COMPLETE
enumeratedValue.description: The state machine goes to this state after the DMA transfers are complete, and determines what step to take next.

enumeratedValue.name: TERMINATE
enumeratedValue.description: When a terminate signal is set, the state machine enters this state until the current AHB transfer is completed.

enumeratedValue.name: WAIT_END
enumeratedValue.description: When the Wait for Command End bit is set, the state machine enters this state until the DMA device indicates that the command is complete.

enumeratedValue.name: WRITE_WAIT

enumeratedValue.name: HALT_AFTER_TERM

enumeratedValue.name: CHECK_WAIT

enumeratedValue.name: WAIT_READY
enumeratedValue.description: When the NAND Wait for Ready bit is set, the state machine enters this state until the GPMI device indicates that the external device is ready.

enumeratedValue.name: DATAFIX_0
enumeratedValue.description: Address comparator triggers a opcode patch

enumeratedValue.name: DATAFIX_1
enumeratedValue.description: Address comparator triggers a data fix

enumeratedValue.name: DIS_0
enumeratedValue.description: Does not affect any ROMC functions (default)

enumeratedValue.name: DIS_1
enumeratedValue.description: Disable all ROMC functions: data fixing, and opcode patching

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Address comparator enabled, ROMC will trigger a opcode patch or data fix event upon matching of the associated address

field.name: RXCLKSRC
field.description: Sample Clock source selection for Flash Reading

enumeratedValue.name: RXCLKSRC_0
enumeratedValue.description: Dummy Read strobe generated by FlexSPI Controller and loopback internally.

enumeratedValue.name: RXCLKSRC_1
enumeratedValue.description: Dummy Read strobe generated by FlexSPI Controller and loopback from DQS pad.

enumeratedValue.name: RXCLKSRC_2
enumeratedValue.description: SCK output clock and loopback from SCK pad

enumeratedValue.name: RXCLKSRC_3
enumeratedValue.description: Flash provided Read strobe and input from DQS pad

field.name: ARDFEN
field.description: Enable AHB bus Read Access to IP RX FIFO.

enumeratedValue.name: ARDFEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: IP RX FIFO should be read by IP Bus. AHB Bus read access to IP RX FIFO memory space will get bus error response.

enumeratedValue.name: ARDFEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: IP RX FIFO should be read by AHB Bus. IP Bus read access to IP RX FIFO memory space will always return data zero but no bus error response.

field.name: ATDFEN
field.description: Enable AHB bus Write Access to IP TX FIFO.

enumeratedValue.name: ATDFEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: IP TX FIFO should be written by IP Bus. AHB Bus write access to IP TX FIFO memory space will get bus error response.

enumeratedValue.name: ATDFEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: IP TX FIFO should be written by AHB Bus. IP Bus write access to IP TX FIFO memory space will be ignored but no bus error response.

field.name: SERCLKDIV
field.description: The serial root clock could be divided inside FlexSPI wrapper. Refer Clocks chapter for more details on clocking.

field.name: HSEN
field.description: Half Speed Serial Flash access Enable.

enumeratedValue.name: HSEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disable divide by 2 of serial flash clock for half speed commands.

enumeratedValue.name: HSEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enable divide by 2 of serial flash clock for half speed commands.

enumeratedValue.name: DOZEEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Doze mode support disabled. AHB clock and serial clock will not be gated off when there is doze mode request from system.

enumeratedValue.name: DOZEEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Doze mode support enabled. AHB clock and serial clock will be gated off when there is doze mode request from system.

field.name: COMBINATIONEN
field.description: This bit is to support Flash Octal mode access by combining Port A and B Data pins (SIOA[3:0] and SIOB[3:0]).

field.name: SCKFREERUNEN
field.description: This bit is used to force SCK output free-running. For FPGA applications, external device may use SCK clock as reference clock to its internal PLL. If SCK free-running is enabled, data sampling with loopback clock from SCK pad is not supported (MCR0[RXCLKSRC]=2).

field.name: LEARNEN
field.description: This bit is used to enable/disable data learning feature. When data learning is disabled, the sampling clock phase 0 is always used for RX data sampling even if LEARN instruction is correctly executed.

field.name: IPGRANTWAIT
field.description: Time out wait cycle for IP command grant.

field.name: AHBGRANTWAIT
field.description: Timeout wait cycle for AHB command grant.

field.name: AHBBUSWAIT
field.description: AHB Read/Write access to Serial Flash Memory space will timeout if not data received from Flash or data not transmited after AHBBUSWAIT * 1024 ahb clock cycles, AHB Bus will get an error response

field.name: SEQWAIT
field.description: Command Sequence Execution will timeout and abort after SEQWAIT * 1024 Serial Root Clock cycles

field.name: ABORTONCMDEN
field.description: Allow Command Sequence Abort during CMD (CMD_SDR/CMD_DDR) instruction.

enumeratedValue.name: ABORTONCMDEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: When command abort request received during CMD instruction, command sequence will wait for the CMD instruction to complete instead of aborting immediately.

enumeratedValue.name: ABORTONCMDEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: When command abort request received during CMD instruction, command sequence will be aborted immediately.

field.name: ABORTONRADDREN
field.description: Allow Command Sequence Abort during RADDR (RADDR_SDR/RADDR_DDR) instructions. Similar as ABORTONCMDEN.

field.name: ABORTONCADDREN
field.description: Allow Command Sequence Abort during RADDR (CADDR_SDR/CADDR_DDR) instructions. Similar as ABORTONCMDEN.

field.name: ABORTONMODEEN
field.description: Allow Command Sequence Abort during MODE (MODE1_SDR/MODE1_DDR/MODE2_SDR/MODE2_DDR/MODE4_SDR/MODE4_DDR/MODE8_SDR/MODE8_DDR) instructions. Similar as ABORTONCMDEN.

field.name: ABORTONDUMMYEN
field.description: Allow Command Sequence Abort during DUMMY (DUMMY_SDR/DUMMY_DDR/DUMMY_RWDS_SDR/DUMMY_RWDS_DDR) instructions. Similar as ABORTONCMDEN.

field.name: ABORTONWRITEEN
field.description: Allow Command Sequence Abort during WRITE (WRITE_SDR/WRITE_DDR) instructions. Similar as ABORTONCMDEN.

field.name: ABORTONREADEN
field.description: Allow Command Sequence Abort during READ (READ_SDR/READ_DDR) instructions. Similar as ABORTONCMDEN.

field.name: ABORTONLEARNEN
field.description: Allow Command Sequence Abort during LEARN (LEARN_SDR/LEARN_DDR) instructions. Similar as ABORTONCMDEN.

field.name: ABORTONDATSZEN
field.description: Allow Command Sequence Abort during DATSZ (DATSZ_SDR/DATSZ_DDR) instructions. Similar as ABORTONCMDEN.

field.name: CLRAHBBUFOPT
field.description: This bit determines whether AHB RX Buffer and AHB TX Buffer will be cleaned automaticaly when FlexSPI returns STOP mode ACK. Software should set this bit if AHB RX Buffer or AHB TX Buffer will be powered off in STOP mode. Otherwise AHB read access after exiting STOP mode may hit AHB RX Buffer or AHB TX Buffer but their data entries are invalid.

enumeratedValue.name: CLRAHBBUFOPT_0
enumeratedValue.description: AHB RX/TX Buffer will not be cleaned automatically when FlexSPI return Stop mode ACK.

enumeratedValue.name: CLRAHBBUFOPT_1
enumeratedValue.description: AHB RX/TX Buffer will be cleaned automatically when FlexSPI return Stop mode ACK.

field.name: SCK2OPT
field.description: This bit controls the SCK2 toggle output.

enumeratedValue.name: SCK2OPT_0
enumeratedValue.description: SCK2 output clock will toggle for READ/LEARN instructions only.

enumeratedValue.name: SCK2OPT_1
enumeratedValue.description: SCK2 output clock will toggle for the whole sequence.

field.name: TSTMD
field.description: This bit is to support ATE test.

enumeratedValue.name: TSTMD_0
enumeratedValue.description: Test mode disable. Sequence execution is started when triggered by IP/AHB command as normal.

enumeratedValue.name: TSTMD_1
enumeratedValue.description: Test mode Enable. Sequence execution is not started after triggered by IP/AHB command, it's blocked until ipt_tester_trigger input (another pin for test) is high. A high pulse of serial clock domain is needed.

field.name: CLRLEARNPHASE
field.description: The sampling clock phase selection will be reset to phase 0 when this bit is written with 0x1. This bit will be auto-cleared immediately.

field.name: SAMEDEVICEEN
field.description: All external devices are same devices (both in types and size) for A1/A2/B1/B2.

enumeratedValue.name: SAMEDEVICEEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: In Individual mode, FLSHA1CRx/FLSHA2CRx/FLSHB1CRx/FLSHB2CRx register setting will be applied to Flash A1/A2/B1/B2 seperately. In Parallel mode, FLSHA1CRx register setting will be applied to Flash A1 and B1, FLSHA2CRx register setting will be applied to Flash A2 and B2. FLSHB1CRx/FLSHB2CRx register settings will be ignored.

enumeratedValue.name: SAMEDEVICEEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: FLSHA1CR0/FLSHA1CR1/FLSHA1CR2 register settings will be applied to Flash A1/A2/B1/B2. FLSHA2CRx/FLSHB1CRx/FLSHB2CRx will be ignored.

field.name: FLASHDQSOPT
field.description: Option bit for Flash device priovided DQS. For internal use only.

enumeratedValue.name: FLASHDQSOPT_0
enumeratedValue.description: FlexSPI will drive toggling SCK output until it receives all flash read data bits, but there will be extra SCK cycle after all read data bits returned on SPI bus.

enumeratedValue.name: FLASHDQSOPT_1
enumeratedValue.description: FlexSPI will drvie SCK output according to read data size and pad number (no extra SCK toggling). If there is DQS latency, FlexSPI will receive less data than required. Never set this bit if there is DQS latency.

field.name: RXDELAYOPT
field.description: Option bit for RX data sampling (when MCR0[RXCLKSRC] is not set to 0x3), for internal use only.

enumeratedValue.name: RXDELAYOPT_0
enumeratedValue.description: FlexSPI will sample RX data lines 4 cycles after SCK edge.

enumeratedValue.name: RXDELAYOPT_1
enumeratedValue.description: FlexSPI will sample RX data lines 5 cycles after SCK edge.

enumeratedValue.name: RXDELAYOPT_2
enumeratedValue.description: FlexSPI will sample RX data lines 6 cycles after SCK edge.

enumeratedValue.name: RXDELAYOPT_3
enumeratedValue.description: FlexSPI will sample RX data lines 7 cycles after SCK edge.

field.name: SCKBDIFFOPT
field.description: SCKB pad can be used as SCKA differential clock output (inverted clock to SCKA). In this case, port B flash access is not available. After change the value of this feild, MCR0[SWRESET] should be set.

enumeratedValue.name: SCKBDIFFOPT_0
enumeratedValue.description: SCKB pad is used as port B SCK clock output. Port B flash access is available.

enumeratedValue.name: SCKBDIFFOPT_1
enumeratedValue.description: SCKB pad is used as port A SCK inverted clock output (Differential clock to SCKA). Port B flash access is not available.

field.name: CLKPHASERST
field.description: All clock output (SCK/DQS/SCK2) phase will be reset by set this bit. After the phase reset, all output clock (SCK/DQS/SCK2) will be low level

field.name: RESUMEWAIT
field.description: Wait cycle (in AHB clock cycle) for idle state before suspended command sequence resumed.

field.name: APAREN
field.description: Parallel mode enabled for AHB triggered Command (both read and write) .

enumeratedValue.name: APAREN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Flash will be accessed in Individual mode.

enumeratedValue.name: APAREN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Flash will be accessed in Parallel mode.

field.name: CLRAHBRXBUF
field.description: Clear the status/pointers of AHB RX Buffer. Auto-cleared.

field.name: CLRAHBTXBUF
field.description: Clear the status/pointers of AHB TX Buffer. Auto-cleared. For internal use only.

field.name: CACHABLEEN
field.description: Enable AHB bus cachable read access support.

enumeratedValue.name: CACHABLEEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. When there is AHB bus cachable read access, FlexSPI will not check whether it hit AHB TX Buffer.

enumeratedValue.name: CACHABLEEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. When there is AHB bus cachable read access, FlexSPI will check whether it hit AHB TX Buffer first.

field.name: BUFFERABLEEN
field.description: Enable AHB bus bufferable write access support. This field affects the last beat of AHB write access, refer for more details about AHB bufferable write.

enumeratedValue.name: BUFFERABLEEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. For all AHB write access (no matter bufferable or non-bufferable hprot[2]=0x1 or 0x0), FlexSPI will return AHB Bus ready after all data is transmitted to External device and AHB command finished.

enumeratedValue.name: BUFFERABLEEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. For AHB bufferable write access, FlexSPI will return AHB Bus ready when the AHB command is granted by arbitrator and will not wait for AHB command finished.

field.name: READADDROPT
field.description: AHB Read Address option bit. This option bit is intend to remove AHB burst start address alignment limitation.

enumeratedValue.name: READADDROPT_0
enumeratedValue.description: There is AHB read burst start address alignment limitation when flash is accessed in parallel mode or flash is wordaddressable.

enumeratedValue.name: READADDROPT_1
enumeratedValue.description: There is no AHB read burst start address alignment limitation. FlexSPI will fetch more datas than AHB burst required to meet the alignment requirement.

field.name: AFLASHBASE
field.description: AHB memory mapped flash base address.

field.name: IPCMDDONEEN
field.description: IP triggered Command Sequences Execution finished interrupt enable.

field.name: IPCMDGEEN
field.description: IP triggered Command Sequences Grant Timeout interrupt enable.

field.name: AHBCMDGEEN
field.description: AHB triggered Command Sequences Grant Timeout interrupt enable.

field.name: IPCMDERREN
field.description: IP triggered Command Sequences Error Detected interrupt enable.

field.name: AHBCMDERREN
field.description: AHB triggered Command Sequences Error Detected interrupt enable.

field.name: IPRXWAEN
field.description: IP RX FIFO WaterMark available interrupt enable.

field.name: IPTXWEEN
field.description: IP TX FIFO WaterMark empty interrupt enable.

field.name: SCKSTOPBYRDEN
field.description: SCK is stopped during command sequence because Async RX FIFO full interrupt enable.

field.name: SCKSTOPBYWREN
field.description: SCK is stopped during command sequence because Async TX FIFO empty interrupt enable.

field.name: AHBBUSTIMEOUTEN
field.description: AHB Bus timeout interrupt.Refer Interrupts chapter for more details.

field.name: SEQTIMEOUTEN
field.description: Sequence execution timeout interrupt enable.Refer Interrupts chapter for more details.

field.name: IPCMDDONE
field.description: IP triggered Command Sequences Execution finished interrupt. This interrupt is also generated when there is IPCMDGE or IPCMDERR interrupt generated.

field.name: IPCMDGE
field.description: IP triggered Command Sequences Grant Timeout interrupt.

field.name: AHBCMDGE
field.description: AHB triggered Command Sequences Grant Timeout interrupt.

field.name: IPCMDERR
field.description: IP triggered Command Sequences Error Detected interrupt. When an error detected for IP command, this command will be ignored and not executed at all.

field.name: AHBCMDERR
field.description: AHB triggered Command Sequences Error Detected interrupt. When an error detected for AHB command, this command will be ignored and not executed at all.

field.name: IPRXWA
field.description: IP RX FIFO watermark available interrupt.

field.name: IPTXWE
field.description: IP TX FIFO watermark empty interrupt.

field.name: SCKSTOPBYRD
field.description: SCK is stopped during command sequence because Async RX FIFO full interrupt.

field.name: SCKSTOPBYWR
field.description: SCK is stopped during command sequence because Async TX FIFO empty interrupt.

field.name: AHBBUSTIMEOUT
field.description: AHB Bus timeout interrupt.Refer Interrupts chapter for more details.

field.name: KEY

enumeratedValue.name: CSINTERVALUNIT_0
enumeratedValue.description: The CS interval unit is 1 serial clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: CSINTERVALUNIT_1
enumeratedValue.description: The CS interval unit is 256 serial clock cycle

field.name: CSINTERVAL
field.description: This field is used to set the minimum interval between flash device Chip selection deassertion and flash device Chip selection assertion. If external flash has a limitation on the interval between command sequences, this field should be set accordingly. If there is no limitation, set this field with value 0x0.

field.name: ARDSEQID
field.description: Sequence Index for AHB Read triggered Command in LUT.

field.name: ARDSEQNUM
field.description: Sequence Number for AHB Read triggered Command in LUT.

field.name: AWRSEQID
field.description: Sequence Index for AHB Write triggered Command.

field.name: AWRSEQNUM
field.description: Sequence Number for AHB Write triggered Command.

field.name: AWRWAIT
field.description: For certain devices (such as FPGA), it need some time to write data into internal memory after the command sequences finished on FlexSPI interface

enumeratedValue.name: AWRWAITUNIT_0
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 2 ahb clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: AWRWAITUNIT_1
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 8 ahb clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: AWRWAITUNIT_2
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 32 ahb clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: AWRWAITUNIT_3
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 128 ahb clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: AWRWAITUNIT_4
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 512 ahb clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: AWRWAITUNIT_5
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 2048 ahb clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: AWRWAITUNIT_6
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 8192 ahb clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: AWRWAITUNIT_7
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 32768 ahb clock cycle

field.name: CLRINSTRPTR
field.description: Clear the instruction pointer which is internally saved pointer by JMP_ON_CS. Refer Programmable Sequence Engine for details.

field.name: SIODOIDLE
field.description: Data pins (SIO) default output level in IDLE state.

field.name: SIODONONIDLE
field.description: Data pins (SIO) default output level in NON-IDLE state (chip selection is asserted).

field.name: SIOOEIDLE
field.description: Data pins (SIO) default output enabled in IDLE state.

field.name: SIOOENONIDLE
field.description: Data pins (SIO) default output enabled in NON-IDLE state (chip selection is asserted).

field.name: WMOPT1
field.description: Write mask option bit 1. This option bit could be used to remove AHB write burst start address alignment limitation.

enumeratedValue.name: WMOPT1_0
enumeratedValue.description: DQS pin will be used as Write Mask when writing to external device. There is no limitation on AHB write burst start address alignment when flash is accessed in individual mode.

enumeratedValue.name: WMOPT1_1
enumeratedValue.description: DQS pin will not be used as Write Mask when writing to external device. There is limitation on AHB write burst start address alignment when flash is accessed in individual mode.

field.name: WMENA
field.description: Write mask enable bit for flash device on port A. When write mask function is needed for memory device on port A, this bit must be set.

enumeratedValue.name: WMENA_0
enumeratedValue.description: Write mask is disabled, DQS(RWDS) pin will be un-driven when writing to external device.

enumeratedValue.name: WMENA_1
enumeratedValue.description: Write mask is enabled, DQS(RWDS) pin will be driven by FlexSPI as write mask output when writing to external device.

field.name: WMENB
field.description: Write mask enable bit for flash device on port B. When write mask function is needed for memory device on port B, this bit must be set.

enumeratedValue.name: WMENB_0
enumeratedValue.description: Write mask is disabled, DQS(RWDS) pin will be un-driven when writing to external device.

enumeratedValue.name: WMENB_1
enumeratedValue.description: Write mask is enabled, DQS(RWDS) pin will be driven by FlexSPI as write mask output when writing to external device.

field.name: SCKRSTDISABLED
field.description: Reset the SCK to default level before PCS signal is desserted. Generally, this bit should not be touched.

enumeratedValue.name: SCKRSTDISABLED_0
enumeratedValue.description: SCK will be reseted to return to default level before PCS signal is desserted.

enumeratedValue.name: SCKRSTDISABLED_1
enumeratedValue.description: SCK will be reseted to return to default level after PCS signal is deseerted.

field.name: SFAR
field.description: Serial Flash Address for IP command.

field.name: IDATSZ
field.description: Flash Read/Program Data Size (in Bytes) for IP command.

field.name: ISEQID
field.description: Sequence Index in LUT for IP command.

field.name: ISEQNUM
field.description: Sequence Number for IP command: ISEQNUM+1.

field.name: IPAREN
field.description: Parallel mode Enabled for IP command.

enumeratedValue.name: IPAREN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Flash will be accessed in Individual mode.

enumeratedValue.name: IPAREN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Flash will be accessed in Parallel mode.

field.name: TRG
field.description: Setting this bit will trigger an IP Command.

field.name: CLRIPRXF
field.description: Clear all valid data entries in IP RX FIFO.

field.name: RXDMAEN
field.description: IP RX FIFO reading by DMA enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: RXDMAEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: IP RX FIFO would be read by processor.

enumeratedValue.name: RXDMAEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: IP RX FIFO would be read by DMA.

field.name: CLRIPTXF
field.description: Clear all valid data entries in IP TX FIFO.

field.name: TXDMAEN
field.description: IP TX FIFO filling by DMA enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: TXDMAEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: IP TX FIFO would be filled by processor.

enumeratedValue.name: TXDMAEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: IP TX FIFO would be filled by DMA.

field.name: DLLRESET
field.description: Software could force a reset on DLL by setting this field to 0x1. This will cause the DLL to lose lock and re-calibrate to detect an ref_clock half period phase shift. The reset action is edge triggered, so software need to clear this bit after set this bit (no delay limitation).

field.name: FORCEUPDATE
field.description: Software could force the slave delay line to update to the DLL calibrated value immediately by setting this bit to 1, The slave delay line shall update automatically based on the SLV_UPDATE_INT interval or when a DLL lock condition is sensed. The force action is edge triggered, so software need to clear this bit after set this bit (no delay limitation). Please force the update only when FlexSPI is in idle state (STS0[ARBIDLE] is 0x0). This bit is for internal use only.

field.name: SLVDLYTARGET
field.description: The delay target for slave delay line is: ((SLVDLYTARGET+1) * 1/32 * clock cycle of reference clock (serial clock).

field.name: GATEUPDATE
field.description: Software could force to gate the update of DLL by set this field. DLL is gated automatically by hardware when there is sample clock toggling to avoid glitches. So this bit is for internal use only.

field.name: OVRDEN
field.description: Slave clock delay line delay cell number selection override enable.

field.name: OVRDVAL
field.description: Slave clock delay line delay cell number selection override value.

field.name: REFPHASEGAP
field.description: Reference clock delay line phase adjust gap.

field.name: REFPHASESTART
field.description: Reference clock delay line start phase.

field.name: LEARNPHASEGAP
field.description: The clock phase gap for data learning is: N delay cells delay (75ps~200ps for each delay cell).

field.name: PHASERSTOPT
field.description: SCK/DQS output clock phase may need reset after a DDR sequence finished (high level). FlexSPI controller will auto reset the clock phase.

enumeratedValue.name: PHASERSTOPT_0
enumeratedValue.description: SCK/DQS output phase will be reset 0.5 cycle after CS de-assertion

enumeratedValue.name: PHASERSTOPT_1
enumeratedValue.description: SCK/DQS output phase will be reset 1.5 cycle after CS de-assertion

enumeratedValue.name: PHASERSTOPT_2
enumeratedValue.description: SCK/DQS output phase will be reset 2.5 cycle after CS de-assertion

enumeratedValue.name: PHASERSTOPT_3
enumeratedValue.description: SCK/DQS output phase will be reset 3.5 cycle after CS de-assertion

field.name: DOEOPT
field.description: FlexSPI controller could delay the data lines output enable desertion by one cycle to relax transmit timing.

enumeratedValue.name: DOEOPT_0
enumeratedValue.description: Data line output enable desertion is delayed by one cycle

enumeratedValue.name: DOEOPT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Data line output enable desertion is not delayed by one cycle

field.name: RWDSOEOPT
field.description: FlexSPI controller could delay the RWDS (write mask) output enable desertion by one cycle to relax transmit timing.

enumeratedValue.name: RWDSOEOPT_0
enumeratedValue.description: RWDS output enable desertion is delayed by one cycle

enumeratedValue.name: RWDSOEOPT_1
enumeratedValue.description: RWDS output enable desertion is not delayed by one cycle

field.name: SEQIDLE
field.description: This status bit indicates the state machine in SEQ_CTL is idle and there is command sequence executing on FlexSPI interface.

field.name: ARBIDLE
field.description: This status bit indicates the state machine in ARB_CTL is busy and there is command sequence granted by arbitrator and not finished yet on FlexSPI interface. When ARB_CTL state (ARBIDLE=0x1) is idle, there will be no transaction on FlexSPI interface also (SEQIDLE=0x1). So this bit should be polled to wait for FlexSPI controller become idle instead of SEQIDLE.

field.name: ARBCMDSRC
field.description: This status field indicates the trigger source of current command sequence granted by arbitrator. This field value is meaningless when ARB_CTL is not busy (STS0[ARBIDLE]=0x1).

enumeratedValue.name: ARBCMDSRC_0
enumeratedValue.description: Triggered by AHB read command (triggered by AHB read).

enumeratedValue.name: ARBCMDSRC_1
enumeratedValue.description: Triggered by AHB write command (triggered by AHB Write).

enumeratedValue.name: ARBCMDSRC_2
enumeratedValue.description: Triggered by IP command (triggered by setting register bit IPCMD.TRG).

field.name: DATALEARNPHASEA
field.description: Indicate the sampling clock phase selection on Port A after Data Learning.

field.name: DATALEARNPHASEB
field.description: Indicate the sampling clock phase selection on Port B after Data Learning.

field.name: AHBCMDERRID
field.description: Indicates the sequence index when an AHB command error is detected. This field will be cleared when INTR[AHBCMDERR] is write-1-clear(w1c).

field.name: AHBCMDERRCODE
field.description: Indicates the Error Code when AHB command Error detected. This field will be cleared when INTR[AHBCMDERR] is write-1-clear(w1c).

enumeratedValue.name: AHBCMDERRCODE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Write/Read data size is not a multiple of 2 bytes while parallel mode is enabled (APAREN=0x1). This error only occur when FLSHCR4.WMOPT is set to 1.

enumeratedValue.name: AHBCMDERRCODE_2
enumeratedValue.description: AHB Write command with JMP_ON_CS instruction used in the sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: AHBCMDERRCODE_3
enumeratedValue.description: There is unknown instruction opcode in the sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: AHBCMDERRCODE_4
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction DUMMY_SDR/DUMMY_RWDS_SDR used in DDR sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: AHBCMDERRCODE_5
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction DUMMY_DDR/DUMMY_RWDS_DDR used in SDR sequence.

field.name: IPCMDERRID
field.description: Indicates the sequence Index when IP command error detected. This field will be cleared when INTR[IPCMDERR] is write-1-clear(w1c).

field.name: IPCMDERRCODE
field.description: Indicates the Error Code when IP command Error detected. This field will be cleared when INTR[IPCMDERR] is write-1-clear(w1c).

enumeratedValue.name: IPCMDERRCODE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Write/Read data size is not a multiple of 2 bytes while parallel mode is enabled (IPAREN=0x1). This error only occur when FLSHCR4.WMOPT is set to 1.

enumeratedValue.name: IPCMDERRCODE_2
enumeratedValue.description: IP command with JMP_ON_CS instruction used in the sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: IPCMDERRCODE_3
enumeratedValue.description: There is unknown instruction opcode in the sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: IPCMDERRCODE_4
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction DUMMY_SDR/DUMMY_RWDS_SDR used in DDR sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: IPCMDERRCODE_5
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction DUMMY_DDR/DUMMY_RWDS_DDR used in SDR sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: IPCMDERRCODE_6
enumeratedValue.description: Flash access start address exceed the whole flash address range (A1/A2/B1/B2).
